Method: 设计RAOA循环架构：在持久潜状态上交替进行"能量导出的问题更新"与"混合更新"；每次混合后重新计算问题场，使得即使跨深度复用同一组学习控制，多次迭代仍具组合性。验证途径包括：精确离散优化、受约束的可编程传播仿真、以及在预训练模型上作为零初始化残差适配器进行适配。

Result: 离散目标上，重复执行可在不增加学习控制数量的情况下提升解质量，且同一形式化可直接处理高阶交互；无源纯相位自由空间模型表明所需算子可由可编程传播近似，在存在实现误差时仍保留有效下游行为；作为零初始化残差适配器时，RAOA在三种模型家族上适配语言模型的WikiText表现接近同等浅层MLP，但推理任务迁移依赖具体模型。RF实现证据为仿真而非硬件验证。

Conclusion: 该工作将交替算子计算、可编程无线电传播与神经适配统一于一个循环框架，表明可编程传播可作为计算深度使用；但RF实现仅停留于仿真层面，缺少硬件实证。

Abstract: Can programmable radio propagation serve as computational depth rather than only as a communication channel or one-shot analog transform? We introduce the Radio Alternating Operator Ansatz (RAOA), a recurrent computing architecture that alternates an energy-derived problem update with a mixing update over a persistent latent state. Recomputing the problem field after each mix makes repeated passes compositional even when the same learned controls are reused across depth. We evaluate this idea through exact discrete optimization, constrained programmable-propagation simulation, and pretrained-model adaptation. On discrete objectives, repeated execution can improve solution quality without increasing the learned-control count, and the same formulation handles higher-order interactions directly. A passive phase-only free-space model further shows that the required operators can be approximated by programmable propagation while retaining useful downstream behavior despite realization error. When inserted as a zero-initialized residual adapter, RAOA adapts pretrained language models with WikiText performance close to a matched shallow MLP across three model families, while reasoning-task transfer remains model-dependent. Together, these results connect alternating-operator computation, programmable radio propagation, and neural adaptation within one recurrent framework. The RF realization evidence is simulation-based rather than a hardware demonstration.

</details>


### [240] [Test-time Calibration Learning for Large Language Model Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02695)
*Zizhuo Zhang,Xiong Peng,Jingwei Sun,Rong Yao,Shixiong Kai,Mingxuan Yuan,Bo Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出免标注的测试时校准学习框架TTCL，在无真值标签的目标任务数据上联合适配推理准确率与言语化置信度，显著提升准确率并降低ECE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠LLM不仅需给出准确答案，还需表达与正确概率相符的置信度，以识别不确定预测并支持现实部署中的可靠决策。已有将校准学习融入强化学习的方法依赖真值正确性监督，在测试时无法获取标签、且需适应新目标任务时适用性受限。

Method: TTCL为无标签框架，直接在无标注目标数据上联合适配推理准确率与言语化置信度；从模型多次生成的多个响应中导出针对正确性与校准的自监督信号，从而在测试时无需真值标签即可进行校准学习。理论分析证明TTCL是理想校准目标的有界代理。

Result: 在数学推理与事实问答上，跨多种模型与任务一致提升准确率和校准。基础模型上八个基准平均相对准确率提升+40.13%，ECE降低+70.80%；在域偏移下对已校准模型仍有效；math-to-factQA设置中平均相对准确率增益+20.35%，ECE降低+53.83%。

Conclusion: TTCL通过多响应自监督信号实现免标签测试时校准学习，是理想校准目标的有界代理，能在无真值标签条件下同时提升准确率与校准，并在域偏移及源域校准迁移不佳时依然有效。代码已开源。

Abstract: Reliable large language models (LLMs) must not only produce accurate answers but also express confidence that faithfully reflects their probability of being correct. Such calibration is essential for identifying uncertain predictions and supporting reliable decision-making in real-world deployment. Recent studies incorporate calibration learning into reinforcement learning (RL), jointly optimizing answer correctness and verbalized confidence using ground-truth correctness supervision. However, their reliance on labeled data limits their applicability in practical test-time settings, where ground-truth labels are unavailable and calibration may need to adapt to newly encountered target tasks. To address this challenge, we propose Test-Time Calibration Learning (TTCL), a label-free framework that jointly adapts reasoning accuracy and verbalized confidence directly on unlabeled target-task data. Specifically, TTCL derives self-supervision signals for both correctness and calibration from multiple model-generated responses, enabling calibration learning at test time without ground-truth labels. Theoretical analysis further establishes TTCL as a bounded surrogate for the ideal calibration objective. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and factual question answering demonstrate that TTCL consistently improves both accuracy and calibration across diverse models and tasks. On base models, TTCL achieves an average relative accuracy improvement of +40.13% and an ECE reduction of +70.80% across eight benchmarks. Moreover, TTCL can further improve both accuracy and calibration for already calibrated models under domain shift, particularly when source-domain calibration transfers poorly to target tasks. In the math-to-factQA setting, TTCL achieves an average relative accuracy gain of +20.35% and reduces ECE by +53.83%. The source code is released at https://github.com/tmlr-group/TTCL.

</details>


### [241] [Learning from Evolving Errors: Adaptive Iterative Repair for On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02700)
*Rui Li,Liyang He,Zheng Zhang,Zhenya Huang,Linbo Zhu,Qi Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AIR-OPD：面向on-policy自蒸馏的自适应迭代修复框架，通过生成"错误到修复"的引导监督，缓解解条件捷径风险，在数学推理基准上稳定提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: On-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）能在学生自采样轨迹上提供稠密的token级反馈，优于强化学习的结果级奖励。但其教师以学生不可见的完整参考解为条件，参考解只指明目标、不指明如何从当前错误走向目标，从而产生"解条件捷径"（solution-conditioned shortcut）风险。为此需要提供从错误到修复的监督信号。

Method: AIR-OPD为自适应迭代修复框架：对失败回答，由引导生成器针对当前错误合成修复引导；学生在该引导下进行on-policy重试；若仍错误，则针对新出现的错误再生成新引导，迭代进行。每一轮中，固定教师以引导作为特权上下文，在学生最新失败回答的"错误对齐区域"上进行监督。并采用结果感知的阶段加权：偏向早期修复阶段，并对即时重试通过验证的阶段给予奖励。引导来源分两类：当前学生策略的自引导与更大模型的外部引导。

Result: 在DAPO-Math-17K上训练，评测AIME24、AIME25、HMMT25，并做MMLU-Pro与GPQA的分布外测试。对Qwen3-4B与Qwen3-8B，AIR-OPD均取得最佳数学推理平均成绩，最高超过最强基线3.6分，同时在分布外基准上保持基座模型性能。

Conclusion: 以"错误到修复"的迭代引导替代单纯参考解条件，可有效规避解条件捷径，兼得稠密监督与稳健泛化；自引导与外部引导均适用，方法对4B与8B规模模型一致有效。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) supplies dense token-level feedback on trajectories sampled from the student's own policy, a richer training signal than the outcome-level rewards of reinforcement learning. This feedback comes from a teacher conditioned on a full reference solution unavailable to the student. The reference solution specifies the target but not how to move from the student's current error toward it, creating a solution-conditioned shortcut risk. We introduce AIR-OPD, an adaptive iterative repair framework for on-policy distillation that provides error-to-repair supervision. Given a failed response, a guidance generator synthesizes repair guidance for the current error. The student samples an on-policy retry with this guidance. If the retry remains incorrect, the generator produces new repair guidance for the newly observed error. At each round, a fixed teacher receives the guidance as privileged context and supervises the student on an error-aligned region of its latest failed response. Outcome-aware stage weighting favors early repair stages and credits stages whose immediate retry passes verification. We train AIR-OPD on the DAPO-Math-17K dataset and evaluate on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25, alongside out-of-distribution tests on MMLU-Pro and GPQA. We examine two guidance sources, self-guidance from the current student policy and external guidance from a larger model. For both Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, AIR-OPD attains the best mathematical-reasoning averages, improving over the strongest baseline by up to 3.6 points, while preserving base-model performance on the out-of-distribution benchmarks.

</details>


### [242] [OPD Before RL: Warm-Starting Rubric-Based RL with On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02781)
*Xinpeng Wang,Wei Shi,Yu-Chia Chen,Maria Zontak,Yun He,Richard Yuanzhe Pang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出两阶段训练框架：先用评分标准（rubric）作为特权教师上下文进行on-policy蒸馏（RP-OPD），再用rubric奖励进行强化学习，在健康与科学任务上取得最优表现且奖励黑客更少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放式语言模型任务的评估难以通过精确结果验证，rubric-based RL虽能对开放回答按显式标准打分，但奖励是在完整回答后统一给出，无法直接指出哪些具体决策促成了最终分数，训练信号缺乏细粒度credit分配。

Method: 两阶段框架。第一阶段RP-OPD：无rubric访问权限的学生模型在自身生成的prefix上，匹配具备rubric访问权限的教师模型的next-token分布，即把rubric当作特权上下文提供dense token-level监督。第二阶段：直接以rubric奖励进行RL，突破蒸馏平台期。实验在健康与科学任务的open-weight模型上，跨HealthBench、ResearchQA、RubricHub Science对比后训练方法，并改变RL前SFT或RP-OPD的训练量。

Result: 在评估的方法中，该两阶段框架得分最高。RP-OPD + RL在RubricHub Science上仅表现出有限的reward hacking迹象，而SFT + RL基线越来越多地通过声称符合rubric却不提供所需内容来获得高奖励。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持：在应用rubric-based RL之前，先利用rubric引导on-policy蒸馏，可提供有效的密集监督并缓解奖励黑客问题。

Abstract: Many useful language-model tasks cannot be evaluated by exact outcome verification. Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) addresses this issue by scoring open-ended responses against explicit criteria. However, because the reward is assigned after the complete response, the training signal does not directly identify which individual decisions contributed to the final score. We propose a two-stage training framework that uses rubrics first as privileged teacher context for dense token-level supervision, then as rewards for further RL. In the first stage, rubric-privileged on-policy distillation (RP-OPD), a student without access to the rubric matches a rubric-aware teacher's next-token distributions at student-generated prefixes. In the second stage, RL directly optimizes the rubric reward and improves beyond the observed distillation plateau. We evaluate the framework on health and science tasks using open-weight models. Across HealthBench, ResearchQA, and RubricHub Science, we compare post-training methods and vary the amount of SFT or RP-OPD training before RL, finding that our two-stage framework achieves the highest scores among the methods evaluated. RP-OPD + RL shows limited signs of reward hacking on RubricHub Science, whereas the SFT + RL baseline increasingly receives high rewards for claims of rubric compliance without providing the required content. These findings support using rubrics to guide on-policy distillation before applying rubric-based RL.

</details>


### [243] [Conditional Capacity and Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Particle Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02701)
*Kaushik Pendiyala,Haris Zia,Trevin Lee,Timothy Legge,Alejandro J. De Leon,Zihan Zhao,Aaron Wang,Abhijith Gandrakota,Jennifer Ngadiuba,Richard Cavanaugh,Javier Duarte*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了稠密与MoE粒子Transformer在JetClass-II上的性能-计算权衡，发现避免token dropping时top-1 MoE以几乎不变的标称前向计算超越稠密基线，但增加存储专家数收益有限；多专家激活可提升精度但计算代价更高，且路由结构与分类性能并非单调相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE可通过增加参数容量而非等比例增加激活计算来扩展模型，但这种权衡在粒子物理Transformer中尚不明确，需要系统评估存储容量、激活计算、路由容量与路由组织等不同维度对喷注分类的影响。

Method: 在188类的JetClass-II数据集上训练稠密与MoE粒子Transformer，系统变化专家数量、路由容量、top-K和辅助损失，并进行路由分析以考察专家分配与粒子身份及运动学特征之间的关联。

Result: 在避免token dropping时，top-1 MoE相比稠密基线在标称前向计算几乎不变的情况下取得提升；进一步增加存储专家数带来的精度增益很小；每token激活多个专家可带来额外预测提升但计算成本更高；专家分配与粒子身份、运动学特征在某些配置下关联更强，但这种结构并不随分类性能单调增强。

Conclusion: 评估喷注分类的稀疏专家模型时，需区分存储参数容量、激活计算量、路由容量与路由组织这四个维度；MoE的收益主要来自top-1路由与避免token dropping，而非单纯扩大存储专家规模。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models can increase parameter capacity without proportionally increasing active computation, but it is unclear how this trade-off behaves in particle-physics transformers. We study dense and MoE Particle Transformers on 188-class JetClass-II, varying expert count, routing capacity, top-K, and auxiliary loss. We find that, when token dropping is avoided, top-1 MoE models improve over the dense baseline at nearly unchanged nominal forward compute, while further increasing the number of stored experts produces little additional accuracy gain. Activating multiple experts per token yields additional predictive improvements at higher computational cost. Routing analyses show that expert assignments become more strongly associated with particle identity and kinematics in some configurations, but this structure does not increase monotonically with classification performance. These results highlight the need to distinguish stored parameter capacity, active computation, routing capacity, and routing organization when evaluating sparse expert models for jet classification. Code and experiment configurations are available at https://github.com/kpendiyala/MPT.

</details>


### [244] [MuonIO: Principled Norm-Aware Descent for Embedding Tables and Language Model Heads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02705)
*Linkai Ma,Xinyu Luo,Mengbo Wang,Ananth Grama,Petros Drineas,Brian Bullins*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MuonIO 为嵌入表和语言模型头提出统一的 Muon 式更新，输入层用 1→2 算子范数、输出层用 2→∞ 算子范数，归约为同一种向量归一化规则，1B LLaMA 预训练中减少 50% 优化器状态内存与约 46% 更新 FLOPs，并改善验证困惑度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 Muon 仅对隐藏线性层应用其原理性更新规则，输入（嵌入表）和输出（语言模型头）层仍使用 AdamW，导致优化器状态与计算开销不统一且内存占用较大，因此需要为这两层设计同样有理论依据的 Muon 式更新。

Method: 针对语言模型头 L∈R^{V×d}，基于 softmax 输出几何的 Lipschitz 连续性，采用 2→∞ 算子范数；针对嵌入表 E∈R^{d×V}，基于 one-hot 输入几何，采用 1→2 算子范数。利用恒等式 ‖L‖_{2→∞}=‖L^T‖_{1→2}，将两者统一到面向词表的几何中，MuonIO 以单一归一化向量规则实现：E 按列归一化，L 按行归一化。

Result: 在 C4 上进行 1B LLaMA 预训练，MuonIO 相比 Muon 将 I/O 优化器状态内存降低 50%、I/O 更新 FLOPs 降低约 46%，同时验证困惑度有所改善。

Conclusion: MuonIO 为输入与输出层提供了统一的 Muon 式更新，兼具有理论动机、内存与计算效率优势，并提升预训练性能，弥补了标准 Muon 对这两层处理不统一的不足。

Abstract: The Muon optimizer derives its update rule for hidden linear layers by solving a local linearization of the loss penalized by the spectral norm, motivated by an RMS-stability argument for dense linear layers. Standard Muon implementations, however, exclude the input (embedding table) and output (language model head) layers from this principled treatment, for which they use AdamW instead. We present MuonIO, a single Muon-style update for both of these layers. For the language model head $\mathbf{L} \in \mathbb{R}^{V \times d}$, we motivate the use of the $2\to\infty$ operator norm, due to the Lipschitz continuity of the softmax output geometry, while for the embedding table $\mathbf{E} \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times V}$, we draw on the $1 \to 2$ operator norm, based on the one-hot input geometry identified by Bernstein & Newhouse (2025). The identity $\lVert\mathbf{L}\rVert_{2\to\infty}=\lVert\mathbf{L}^\top\rVert_{1\to2}$ then puts both matrices in the same vocabulary-oriented geometry: MuonIO applies a single normalized-vector rule, which appears as column normalization for $\mathbf{E}$ and row normalization for $\mathbf{L}$. Empirical evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, with MuonIO reducing I/O optimizer state memory by 50% and I/O update FLOPs by $\sim$46% compared to Muon for 1B LLaMA pretraining on C4, while also improving validation perplexity.

</details>


### [245] [Differential Privacy of Gradient Descent on Perturbed Objectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02716)
*Austin Watkins,Raman Arora*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究目标扰动下有限次梯度下降迭代的隐私与统计性质，证明在强凸光滑且Hessian Lipschitz条件下扰动到迭代的映射是C^1微分同胚，并给出雅可比最小奇异值下界，从而对有限迭代进行变量替换分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典目标扰动释放精确最小值点，但实际只能获得有限步优化迭代结果，因此需要分析有限迭代下目标扰动的隐私保证与风险界。

Method: 对正则化经验风险加随机线性项，释放确定性梯度下降第N次迭代；在强凸、光滑、Hessian Lipschitz条件下证明z映射到w_N为C^1微分同胚并定量下界其雅可比最小奇异值，进而用变量替换分析有限迭代。

Result: 对广义线性模型，迭代条件满足后隐私轮廓界不含显式环境维数因子，有限迭代修正几何递减；随N缓慢增长截断参数可恢复精确最小值的隐私证书；期望超额经验风险为dσ^2/(2μ)加几何递减优化项，并可迁移到总体风险且主导统计项无额外条件数乘性因子。

Conclusion: 有限次梯度下降迭代即可在目标扰动框架下获得近似精确最小值的隐私与风险保证，且迭代修正几何衰减、主项维度依赖得以消除。

Abstract: Objective perturbation adds a random linear term to a regularized empirical risk and releases the exact perturbed minimizer. We study the finite computation obtained by releasing the $N$-th iterate of deterministic gradient descent on $w\mapsto F(w;S)+\langle z,w\rangle$, where $z\sim\mathcal N(0,σ^2I_d)$ is drawn once before optimization. For strongly convex and smooth objectives with Lipschitz Hessian, we prove an explicit condition under which the map $z\mapsto w_N$ is a $C^1$-diffeomorphism on the bounded domains used in the privacy argument, with a quantitative lower bound on the smallest singular value of its Jacobian. This permits a direct change-of-variables analysis of the finite iterate. For generalized linear models, the resulting privacy-profile bound has no explicit ambient-dimension factor once the iteration condition holds, and its finite-iteration correction decreases geometrically. By letting the free truncation parameter grow slowly with $N$, we recover the corresponding exact-minimizer certificate in the limit. We also bound the expected excess empirical risk by $dσ^2/(2μ)$ plus a geometrically decreasing optimization term, and transfer the result to population risk without an additional multiplicative condition-number factor in the leading statistical terms.

</details>


### [246] [To Explore The Strange New World Beyond Data Distribution: System Behavior, Causality Tax, and Non-causal Base Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02839)
*Xianzhi Zeng,Jiangneng Li,Gao Cong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出SBD框架，将系统行为$S$作为第一性贝叶斯特征引入ELBO，揭示"因果税"现象，并提出非因果变分族GSH以降低该税并提升泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型以因果性为事实标准架构基础，但近期研究表明其与因果性存在持续的不匹配与矛盾；这些问题主要源于系统行为（数据空间之外的额外主导因素，且涉及耦合效应），而非数据分布。因此作者质疑因果性对语言模型的必要性与最优性。

Method: 提出SBD框架，将系统行为$S$作为ELBO中不可约的组成部分；通过隐式测量、理论界引导的控制以及神经正切核（NTK）评估来验证SBD所预测的$S$的影响；并构建Green Shell（GSH）——一种非因果变分族，用分治式划分替代$S$分量之间的顺序依赖链。

Result: SBD从理论上揭示反直觉的"因果税"现象：由于对$S$的忽视，因果性表现为带有额外结构误差的次优近似。NTK谱（惰性训练区制）证实GSH始终取得显著更紧的误差界，信噪比提升$7dB+$；在惰性训练相对后期，GSH进一步带来更优泛化（多尺度拟合能力提升至多$20\%$）。

Conclusion: SBD将系统行为确立为除因果性与分布拟合之外的互补理论抽象，为设计与优化语言模型基座模型等方向开辟了新研究路径。

Abstract: We show that the causality of language models (LMs) may not be necessary nor optimal. This is the case when system behavior (denoted as $S$) is incorporated as a first-principle Bayesian feature. Here, $S$ refers to extra dominant factors beyond the data space, and they involve coupled effects. Despite being the de facto foundation of modern architecture, recent studies indicate persistent mismatches and contradictions with causality. These issues largely stem from system behavior rather than the data distribution. We therefore propose the SBD framework, which incorporates $S$ as an irreducible component of the evidence lower bound (ELBO). SBD theoretically reveals a counter-intuitive Causality Tax phenomenon, where causality emerges as a suboptimal approximation with an additional structural error, due to the obliviousness to $S$. To address the challenge of latent variable analysis, we validate the SBD-predicted impact of $S$ via implicit measurements, theoretical-bound-guided controls, and Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) evaluations. In particular, we construct Green Shell (GSH) to show the possibility of reducing Causality Tax. GSH is a non-causal variational family, and it replaces the sequential dependency chain of $S$ components with a divide-and-conquer partition. NTK spectra in the lazy-training regime confirm that GSH always achieves significantly tighter error bounds than causality, with $7dB+$ improvement in signal-to-noise ratio. In the relatively later stage of lazy-training, GSH further leads to superior generalization (up to $20\%$ richer multi-scale fitting capabilities). Taken together, SBD establishes system behavior as a complementary theoretical abstraction besides causality and distribution fitting, opening new research avenues such as designing and optimizing LM base models.

</details>


### [247] [Structural-Functional Brain Connectivity Generation via Multimodal Hypergraph-based Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02722)
*Chyong Yi Poh,Hwa Hui Tew,Junn Yong Loo,Raphaël C. -W. Phan,Fuad Noman,Pew-Thian Yap,Chee-Ming Ting*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MHG-FM框架，用超图+流匹配实现脑结构-功能连接（SC-FC）联合生成与跨模态翻译，在HCP-YA上多项指标优于SOTA且采样约快8倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模配对的SC-FC数据稀缺，现有生成方法用配对图仅建模二元（dyadic）交互，且SC与FC独立生成，难以保留高阶的结构-功能关系，因此需要能够联合建模并保持高阶耦合的生成与跨模态翻译方法。

Method: 提出Multimodal Hypergraph Flow Matching（MHG-FM）：为每个模态构建模态特定的超图（hypergraph），用超图神经网络（HGNN）编码器学习高阶表示；通过双向双交叉注意力（Dual Cross-Attention, DCA）进行跨模态融合；再用变分自编码器（VAE）将融合表示映射到紧致潜空间，在潜空间中以条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）实现潜变量传输，从而完成连接合成与多模态翻译。

Result: 在Human Connectome Project Young Adult（HCP-YA）数据集上，MHG-FM在重建质量、拓扑保持、分布相似性和SC-FC耦合度上优于多个SOTA基线，采样速度比同等扩散（diffusion）骨干约快8倍。

Conclusion: 超图建模高阶交互结合条件流匹配的潜空间传输，可有效支持SC-FC的联合生成与跨模态翻译；在保持结构-功能耦合与拓扑特性的同时显著提升采样效率，为神经影像中配对数据稀缺问题提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Structural connectivity (SC) and functional connectivity (FC) provide complementary information on interactions between brain regions and are widely used in neuroimaging studies of neuropsychiatric disorders. Generative modelling can alleviate the scarcity of large-scale paired SC-FC data, but existing approaches typically use pairwise graphs that capture only dyadic interactions and often generate SC and FC independently, limiting preservation of higher-order structure-function relationships. We propose a Multimodal Hypergraph Flow Matching (MHG-FM) framework for joint SC-FC connectivity generation and cross-modal translation. MHG-FM constructs modality-specific hypergraphs, learns higher-order representations with Hypergraph Neural Network (HGNN) encoders, and performs bidirectional cross-modal fusion using Dual Cross-Attention (DCA). A variational autoencoder maps the fused representations to a compact latent space, where conditional flow matching enables connectivity synthesis and multimodal translation via latent transport. Experiments on the Human Connectome Project Young Adult (HCP-YA) dataset show that MHG-FM outperforms several state-of-the-art baselines in reconstruction quality, topology preservation, distributional similarity, and SC-FC coupling, while achieving approximately 8x faster sampling than a matched diffusion backbone.

</details>


### [248] [Probe the Harness: Setup Checks for Stale-Data RL Comparisons in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02911)
*Taiheng Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出陈旧样本训练方法的比较结论高度依赖实验框架细节，并提出了PTH检查清单以暴露这些细节；案例中四项框架细节反转了SAN与TIS的排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法（如SAN与截断重要性采样TIS）的优劣判断依赖于与重要性校正基线的对比，但实验框架（harness）中的实现细节往往不可见，可能导致比较结果被错误地反转，从而影响方法评价的可靠性。

Method: 作者以SAN与TIS在verl和单GPU训练器上的对比为案例，提出PTH（Probe The Harness）检查方法，逐一识别并验证框架细节对比较的影响：PPO比率基于学习器自身重算概率、数据种子未传入TIS分支、回放队列首个批次被复用33次更新、以及两个损失归一化器与描述不符。

Result: 初始实验中SAN在两个平台上均领先。修正框架细节后，TIS在verl上与SAN持平；在单GPU训练器中TIS稳定学习，而SAN保持一定优势。作者还给出了每个细节的特征（signature）及其对比较的影响，并提供了TIS与未校正GRPO在采样滞后下的参考结果及PTH检查清单。

Conclusion: 实验框架细节足以反转方法比较排名，且日志中看似正常的量掩盖了定义比较的关键量未被检查的问题；因此需要PTH这类显式检查来保证比较的公平与可复现。

Abstract: Methods for training language models on stale samples are judged by comparisons against importance-corrected baselines. We show that details of the experimental harness can reverse the observed ranking of methods, and we introduce PTH (Probe The Harness), a set of checks that makes the harness visible. Our case is a comparison between SAN, a behaviour-free method, and truncated importance sampling (TIS) on verl and in a single-GPU trainer, in which SAN first finished ahead in both stacks. Four details of the harness changed this comparison: the PPO ratio was taken against the learner's own recomputed probabilities, the data seed did not reach the TIS arm, the replay queue reused its first batch for 33 updates, and two loss normalisers differed from their description. In each case the logged quantity looked consistent with a working setup, while the quantity that defines the comparison went unchecked. With the harness checked, TIS matches SAN on verl, and in the trainer TIS learns steadily while SAN keeps a margin. We contribute the signature of each detail and its effect on the comparison, reference results for TIS and uncorrected GRPO under sampler lag, and the PTH checklist.

</details>


### [249] [Bellman Error Minimization Via Linear Programming Normalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02730)
*Haining Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的函数逼近方法，用于降低高维动态规划与强化学习中的贝尔曼误差，并以收益管理中的网络容量控制问题为动机示例，将深度神经网络与线性规划逼近算法相结合求解动态规划近似解，仿真显示其性能与基准方法相比具有竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维动态规划与强化学习问题中普遍存在贝尔曼误差较大的难题，传统函数逼近方法在维数膨胀时精度与可扩展性受限，因此需要新的函数逼近途径来降低贝尔曼误差。

Method: 提出一种新的函数逼近框架，将深度神经网络与线性规划逼近算法相结合，构造动态规划问题的近似解；以收益管理中的网络容量控制这一经典动态规划问题作为动机示例进行建模与验证。

Result: 仿真实验表明，所提出的逼近算法在性能上与基准方法相比具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 深度神经网络与线性规划逼近的结合可为高维动态规划问题提供有效的近似求解途径，并有助于降低贝尔曼误差，具有应用于强化学习与收益管理等场景的潜力。

Abstract: This paper proposes a new functional approximation approach to reduce Bellman error in high-dimensional dynamic programming and Reinforcement Learning problems. Using a classic dynamic programming problem (network capacity control in revenue management) as the motivational example, the paper illustrates that deep neural networks and linear programming approximation algorithms can be combined to derive approximate solutions to dynamic programming problems. Simulation results show the proposed approximation algorithms achieves competitive performance when compared with benchmark.

</details>


### [250] [Inner Momentum for Differentially Private Muon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02738)
*Bishnu Bhusal,Minh Vu,Ben Southworth,Geigh Zollicoffer,Rohit Chadha,Manish Bhattarai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对差分隐私训练中逐样本梯度裁剪会扭曲平均梯度奇异向量几何、进而损害 Muon 优化器（其更新依赖近似极因子 UV^T）的问题，提出在裁剪前将每个样本的 Muon 梯度在当前模型与近期模型历史上做平均（DP-Muon-IM），并给出裁剪矩阵分解与失真上界及 Newton-Schulz 迭代保极因子的理论保证，在私有 GPT-2 微调上取得稳定提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 差分隐私训练需对每个样本梯度做径向裁剪再加噪，由于各样本裁剪因子不同（不等比例缩放），会扭曲其平均梯度的相对奇异向量几何。Muon 的更新是近似极因子 UV^T，仅依赖奇异向量，因此对这种裁剪引起的几何失真尤为敏感。论文旨在缓解该退化。

Method: 提出 DP-Muon-IM：在裁剪之前，将每个采样样本的 Muon 梯度在当前模型与一段近期模型历史上进行平均。经此处理后，裁剪后的批量矩阵可分解为一个共同缩放项与一个采样梯度与裁剪值之间的协方差残差 R，且 ||R||_F <= sigma_lambda sigma_G，从而直接约束裁剪引起的失真。进一步证明在相应谱条件下，有限步 Newton-Schulz 迭代保持输入的极因子，说明该校正能在正交化后保留。

Result: 在 E2E 和 DART 数据集上对 GPT-2 进行差分隐私微调，epsilon 取 {1, 2, 4, 8}：DP-Muon-IM 在所有同种子配对比较中均提升 BLEU 与 ROUGE-L，优于 DP-Muon；非私有诊断显示噪声前极误差降低 2-4%。

Conclusion: 通过在裁剪前对样本 Muon 梯度做模型历史平均，可有效抑制差分隐私裁剪对奇异向量几何的失真，并在理论上给出失真上界与正交化保持性，在私有 GPT-2 微调任务上一致优于 DP-Muon。

Abstract: Differentially private training clips each per-example gradient before adding noise. This clipping is radial for each example, yet unequal clipping factors can distort the relative singular-vector geometry of their average. Muon is particularly exposed to this effect, since its update is an approximate polar factor UV^T that depends only on the singular vectors that clipping can shift. To curb this degradation, we propose averaging each sampled example's Muon gradient over the current model and a short history of recent models before clipping. The clipped batch matrix then separates into a common rescaling and a covariance residual R between sampled gradients and clipping values, with ||R||_F <= sigma_lambda sigma_G, bounding the clipping-induced distortion directly. We further show that a finite Newton-Schulz iteration preserves the polar factor of its input under these spectral conditions, confirming that our correction survives orthogonalization. In private GPT-2 fine-tuning on E2E and DART at epsilon in {1, 2, 4, 8}, DP-Muon-IM improves BLEU and ROUGE-L over DP-Muon in every seed-matched comparison, and non-private diagnostics show 2-4% lower pre-noise polar error.

</details>


### [251] [Understanding Trajectory Heterogeneity in Federated World Model Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02957)
*Yipan Wei,Zhaokun Yan,Ziming Hong,Jiaqi Wu,Lixu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在MIMIC-IV八种疾病队列上构建跨时间联邦学习基准（4087万转移样本），揭示客户端所有权与参与率共同限制长时窗覆盖，并发现严重度细分区通常伴随FedAvg误差升高、算法增益有限且依赖预测时长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型依赖轨迹中的时间上下文进行状态演化学习，而联邦学习虽可利用分布式记录，但轨迹的所有权边界限制了各客户端可构造的样本，因此需要系统评估这种跨时间联邦场景。

Method: 在MIMIC-IV的八个疾病队列上开展逐小时动作条件临床预测基准，共4087万转移成员关系；设计基于严重度的客户端所有权、患者分离构造、局部历史与未来窗口规则，以及1至32小时的配对滚动评估；在五轮10%参与率下，对32种疾病-划分配置测试十种联邦算法。

Result: ① 客户端所有权与参与率共同限制长窗口覆盖，跨疾病平均仅7.55%–21.36%的池化可用32步窗口在训练中被本地完整锚点访问；② 16组配对比较中有15组显示更细的严重度划分伴随更高的FedAvg误差，算法增益小且依赖时长（FedProx平均误差降低0.56%，32步时无一致改善）；③ 算法标签掩盖了不同的更新行为，包括非活跃外推与更新尺度数量级差异，缓存更新性能在同一协议下因轨迹划分而显著变化。

Conclusion: 结果表明，时间可达性、参与覆盖率、优化行为与时长分辨预测构成评估联邦临床世界模型的互补维度。

Abstract: World models learn state evolution from trajectories, making access to temporal context a central training requirement. Federated learning can use distributed records, while ownership boundaries within a trajectory restrict the examples each client can construct. Our study benchmarks this cross-time setting through hourly action-conditioned clinical prediction on eight MIMIC-IV disease cohorts, comprising 40.87 million transition memberships. We specify severity-based client ownership, patient-separated construction, local history and future-window rules, and paired rollout evaluation from one to 32 hours. A matrix of ten federated algorithms covers 32 disease--partition configurations under five rounds of ten-percent participation. Three findings emerge from existing results and training logs. First, client ownership and participation jointly restrict long-window coverage: only 7.55\%--21.36\% of pooled-available 32-step windows have a locally complete anchor visited during training, averaged across diseases. Second, finer severity partitions accompany higher FedAvg error in 15 of 16 paired comparisons, while algorithm gains are small and horizon-dependent: FedProx reduces mean error by 0.56\%, with no consistent improvement at 32 steps. Third, algorithm labels conceal distinct update behavior, including inactive extrapolation and orders-of-magnitude differences in update scale. Cached-update performance also varies strongly across trajectory partitions under the same benchmark protocol. These results establish temporal access, participation coverage, optimization behavior, and horizon-resolved prediction as complementary dimensions for evaluating federated clinical world models.

</details>


### [252] [Prospective Hindsight: Self-Calibrating Reinforcement Learning via Prediction-Reality Gaps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02740)
*Jiaxin Zhang,Xiangyu Peng,Qinglin Chen,Yu Li,Hiroaki Hayashi,Chien-Sheng Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Prospective Hindsight（PH）训练原则，通过前瞻预测与回溯评估之间的"surprise"信号对样本梯度加权，使智能体在长时程任务中同时提升任务表现与校准度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程强化学习仅依赖纯回溯性训练信号，信用分配只在观察到环境后果后进行，导致智能体在动作时刻的信念对梯度不可见，无法显式纠正其自我模型的不准确之处。

Method: PH在任何回溯式基础方法上增加一个由"前瞻预测（反馈前）"与"回溯评估（反馈后）"之差导出的信号。该per-rollout surprise用于识别自模型最不准确的样本，并通过stop-gradient的surprise加权优势放大其梯度贡献。前瞻预测器与策略共享参数，二者协同演化，逐步聚焦剩余盲点。作者将其联系到privileged-information gap，并证明最小化surprise残差为降低误校准率提供下降路径。

Result: 在单轮可验证任务和多轮个人助理任务上（基于GRPO、on-policy distillation及其组合），PH同时提升任务表现与校准度，且跨模型规模取得一致增益。误校准主导模式在不同场景间结构性转移：单轮为过度自信的失败，多轮为信心不足的成功，而同一训练原则均能有效应对。

Conclusion: 校准可作为优化的副产品自然涌现，而非依赖额外的目标函数；PH以自校准方式将动作时刻的信念纳入梯度，统一改善任务性能与校准，并适用于不同误校准模式。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents relies on purely retrospective training signals: credit is assigned only after observing environmental consequences, leaving the agent's belief at action time invisible to the gradient. We introduce Prospective Hindsight (PH), a self-calibrating training principle that augments any retrospective base method with a signal derived from the gap between the agent's prospective prediction (before feedback) and the retrospective evaluation (after feedback). This per-rollout surprise identifies samples where the agent's self-model is most inaccurate and amplifies their gradient contribution through a stop-gradient surprise-weighted advantage. Since the prospective predictor shares parameters with the policy, the two co-evolve, progressively shifting focus to the agent's remaining blind spots. We connect this principle to a privileged-information gap and show that minimizing the surprise residual provides a descent pathway on the agent's miscalibration rate; calibration thus emerges as a byproduct of optimization rather than from an added objective. On single-turn verifiable tasks and a multi-turn personal-agent task (under GRPO, on-policy distillation, and their combination), PH improves both task performance and calibration, with consistent gains across model scales. Notably, the dominant miscalibration mode shifts structurally between regimes, overconfident failures in single-turn, underconfident successes in multi-turn, yet the same training principle addresses both successfully.

</details>


### [253] [Sentry: Learning to Recover from LLM Agent Failures at Test Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02994)
*Changxiu Ji,Amy Lu,Qizheng Zhang,Kunle Olukotun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出失败知识是"条件性知识"，应条件性暴露，并实例化为Sentry失败管理模块，通过外部playbook按需检索经验并验证恢复，避免将完整失败经验放入上下文，在多个agent基准上显著超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent常因无效工具调用、重复动作或缺乏依据的推理而在任务中途失败，从失败中学习是提升可靠性的路径。但失败知识具有条件性：常驻上下文会在对应失败不存在时产生误触发，而从不断演化的playbook中移除失败经验反而提升性能；运行时干预只在失败发生时起作用，却不从修复中学习。因此需要解决"失败知识如何到达agent"这一被忽视的问题。

Method: 作者将失败知识视为条件性知识并主张条件性暴露，实例化为Sentry——一个与agent并行运行的失败管理层。当Sentry检测到失败时，从外部playbook中检索匹配的经验以指导恢复；随后在不访问任务奖励的条件下验证agent是否真正恢复；仅当恢复成功时才存储新经验。完整playbook始终不进入agent上下文。

Result: 在多个agent基准上，Sentry在每个基准上都优于最强的运行时干预基线，平均提升37%；在同时评估两者的两个基准上，优于最强的上下文演化基线39%；Sentry与上下文演化结合可带来进一步提升。学到的经验可迁移到留出任务；对照实验显示，即使相关经验仍可按需获取，将完整playbook暴露给agent也会降低性能。

Conclusion: 失败知识本质上是条件性的，应当条件性暴露而非常驻上下文。Sentry通过在失败发生时按需检索经验、以恢复结果作为验证信号并仅沉淀有效经验，实现了不依赖任务奖励的失败管理，提升了agent可靠性，且与上下文演化方法互补。

Abstract: LLM agents often fail mid-task due to invalid tool calls, repeated actions, or poorly grounded reasoning, and learning from these failures is a path to reliability. We find that how failure knowledge reaches the agent matters as much as what it contains. Failure lessons are conditional: kept in the agent's context, they misfire when their failure is absent, and removing them from an evolving playbook improves performance. Runtime interventions, in contrast, act only when a failure occurs but do not learn from their repairs. We argue that failure knowledge is conditional knowledge and should be conditionally exposed, and instantiate this principle in Sentry, a failure-management layer that runs alongside the agent. When Sentry detects a failure, it retrieves matching lessons from an external playbook to guide recovery, verifies without access to task rewards whether the agent recovered, and stores a new lesson only if it did; the full playbook never enters the agent's context. Across multiple agentic benchmarks, Sentry outperforms the strongest runtime-intervention baseline on every benchmark, by 37\% on average, and the strongest context-evolution baseline by 39\% on the two benchmarks where both are evaluated; combining Sentry with context evolution yields further gains. Learned lessons transfer to held-out tasks, and controlled experiments show that exposing the full playbook to the agent lowers performance even when relevant lessons remain available on demand.

</details>


### [254] [Jumping up and down: Denoiser diffusion models for discrete ordinal data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02754)
*Yair Shenfeld,Ricardo Baptista,Stefano Peluchetti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出JUD（Jumping Up and Down），首个面向离散有序数据的基于去噪器的扩散模型族，支持双向（上/下）扰动，并在多模态数据上取得有竞争力的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在图像、视频等连续空间及语言等类别数据的离散扩散方面发展迅速，但针对离散整数值（有序）数据的扩散模型研究不足，而这类数据（图像、音乐、基因计数等）十分普遍，存在方法空白。

Method: 提出JUD——一种新的面向离散有序数据的、基于去噪器的扩散模型族。其核心是围绕训练去噪器进行建模，并支持数据的双向（向上和向下）扰动，训练目标简单且扰动方式灵活。

Result: 得益于简化的训练目标和双向扰动的灵活性，JUD在多种不同数据模态上取得了有竞争力的结果。

Conclusion: JUD填补了离散有序数据扩散建模的空白，验证了去噪器训练与双向扰动结合的可行性与有效性，为面向整数值/有序数据的生成建模提供了新方向。

Abstract: Diffusion models are highly developed in continuous spaces for image and video domains. Recently, major advances have been made for discrete diffusion models for categorical data, specifically in the language domain. In contrast, diffusion models for discrete integer-valued data are less developed, despite the prevalence of this modality, ranging from images and music to gene counts. We introduce Jumping Up and Down (JUD)---a new family of denoiser-based diffusion models for discrete ordinal data. This is the first family of diffusion models for ordinal data which centers around training denoisers, which at the same time allows for bi-directional (up and down) perturbations of the data. The simplicity of the training objective, combined with the flexibility of bi-directional perturbations, leads us to obtain competitive results across different data modalities.

</details>


### [255] [A Two-Stage Cascade for Near-Real-Time Forest Anomaly Detection from Sentinel-1 SAR Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02763)
*Pann Thinzar Seint,Subas Chhatkuli,Bryan Atwood*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种“统计检验+自编码器确认”两阶段级联方法，利用Sentinel-1时间序列实现近实时热带森林损失异常检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 热带森林监测对气候稳定和生物多样性保护至关重要，非法采伐干预、供应链透明、土地利用治理和碳市场标准都需要快速可靠的森林损失检测。现有遥感监测面临两大挑战：光学监测受云覆盖限制，SAR系统又易将季节性后向散射变化误判为森林损失。

Method: 两阶段统计-编码器级联架构：（1）对配准后的Sentinel-1 VH后向散射，结合同季节历史基线，采用自适应鲁棒统计z-score检验；（2）基于稳定森林斑块训练的卷积自编码器，用潜空间结构相似性（SSIM）构建学习型确认门。仅当两阶段一致时才确认扰动为告警，并根据重复发生历史赋予置信度和低/中/高风险等级。

Result: 系统可输出每条告警的可审计置信度分数和以公顷计的面积估计，直接兼容MRV工作流、可持续森林管理、现场核查和环境风险评估。

Conclusion: 该方法兼顾快速性与可靠性，并具可扩展性，可应用于选择性采伐、大规模农业侵占制图、洪水制图等环境监测场景。

Abstract: Tropical forest monitoring is essential for global climate stability and biodiversity preservation. To address the urgent need for rapid, reliable detection of forest loss which is essential for timely intervention against illegal logging, supply chain transparency, land-use governance and carbon market standards, we introduce a two-stage statistics-encoder cascade for near-real-time anomaly detection using Sentinel-1 time series. Our system is designed to overcome two fundamental challenges in remote sensing: the cloud-cover limitations that restrict optical monitoring and seasonal backscatter variation that causes SAR systems to mistake natural moisture changes for forest loss. The architecture integrates two distinct analytical engines to ensure high-fidelity detection: (1) an adaptive, robust-statistics z-score test on co-registered Sentinel-1 VH backscatter, same-season historical baseline and (2) a learned confirmation gate based on the latent-space structural similarity (SSIM) of a convolutional autoencoder trained on stable-forest patches. A candidate disturbance is confirmed as an alert only when both stages agree, and is assigned a confidence score and a Low/Medium/High risk tier from its repeat-occurrence history. The system produces per-alert auditable confidence scores and area-in-hectares estimates directly compatible with Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) workflows, sustainable forestry management, operational field checks and environmental risk assessments. Beyond its primary application, the model's flexibility allows for critical environmental applications ranging from selective logging to large-scale agricultural encroachment mapping, flood mapping and so on.

</details>


### [256] [A Controlled Audit of Personal AI Memory for Rating Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02764)
*Shivam Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究通过用户内历史评分置换实验，分离“历史物品-评分关联”与“用户评分倾向”对结构化评分预测的作用，发现Mem0式记忆提取管线在Coat数据集上反而增加误差，且关联利用效果具领域依赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在结构化评分预测中，个人AI究竟依赖历史物品-评分关联，还是主要依赖用户评分倾向，这一区分尚未被系统审查；需揭示记忆提取、关联利用、输出可靠性与读者选择各自独立的影响。

Method: 在400个留出用户画像、6,160个目标评分（Coat与MovieLens）上进行公开冻结评估。通过用户内置换历史评分，保持评分分布、物品支持度与元数据不变；结合完整历史、原生记忆提取（Qwen-written Mem0管线）与匹配的数值读取器进行对照。采用家族校正自助法区间，并设固定回退规则保留全部2,800次读取调用（含150个无效输出）；另有独立实现校验输入、指标及全部十个主要对比。

Result: Coat数据集上，Mem0管线相对完整历史使用户宏平均绝对误差增加：Qwen +0.084、Phi +0.149，家族校正自助区间均排除零。正确历史分配对两个读取器在Coat均有帮助，而MovieLens对应效应较小且校正后不确定。仅历史的岭回归读取器在两域均优于Qwen，在MovieLens上优于Phi，Coat上Phi对比未定。

Conclusion: 记忆提取、关联利用、输出可靠性与读取器选择需分别评估；仅依赖“历史关联”或“评分倾向”的单一解释不足，当前Mem0式提取管线在部分场景下并未有效利用正确历史关联。

Abstract: In structured rating prediction, does a personal AI use historical item-rating associations, or mainly the user's rating tendencies? We audit this distinction by permuting historical ratings within each user while preserving the exact rating distribution, item support, and metadata. We combine this control with full history, native memory extraction, and matched numerical readers in a publicly frozen evaluation of 400 held-out user profiles and 6,160 target ratings across Coat and MovieLens. On Coat, the tested Qwen-written Mem0 pipeline increases user-macro mean absolute error relative to full history by 0.084 for Qwen and 0.149 for Phi; both family-adjusted bootstrap intervals exclude zero. Correct historical assignments help both readers on Coat, but the corresponding MovieLens effects are smaller and inconclusive after adjustment. A history-only ridge reader outperforms Qwen in both domains and Phi on MovieLens, while the Coat Phi comparison is unresolved. All 2,800 reader calls, including 150 invalid outputs, are retained under a fixed fallback rule. A separate implementation verifies inputs, metrics, and all ten primary contrasts. The contribution is a reproducible diagnostic study showing why extraction, association use, output reliability, and reader choice require separate evaluation.

</details>


### [257] [Exact Memory-Time Optimization for Prefix-Cached Language Model Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02766)
*Shivam Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Prefix-Certificate Retention (PCR)，一种针对静态、分组、访问重置超时的精确有限轨迹前缀状态保留优化模型，将最大权闭包归约为最小割，并给出突破点定理与动态规划方法，通过 Mooncake 请求回放验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型前缀状态保留需要在重计算与存储时间之间权衡。独立优化每个缓存块会高估收益，因为一个驻留块只有在所需的前置前缀同样可用时才真正可用，因此需要一种能精确刻画前缀依赖关系的保留策略优化方法。

Method: 提出 PCR 的精确有限轨迹建模，针对静态、分组、访问重置超时。将可用前缀收益表示为以超时阈值和前置命中证书为前置条件的节点，把最大权闭包问题归约为一次最小割，图规模与块查找和超时选择数成线性关系。通过突破点定理将构造扩展到所有非负超时且无数值离散误差；针对有序超时导出按网格规模线性的动态规划，并给出该限制代价的界。使用小规模穷举检查与 39,632 条公开 Mooncake 请求的时间顺序回放进行验证。

Result: 在固定网格上，120 个轨迹分组价格案例中有 118 个由有序超时达到无限制训练最优。异构保留改善了若干留出集上的内存-时间权衡，但更精细的训练优化并未一致地提升迁移效果。实验度量的是可用前缀块与存储时间，而非 GPU 延迟。

Conclusion: 本文贡献是一个可处理的优化模型与可审计的保留策略基准；PCR 提供了精确的有限轨迹形式化，最小割归约与突破点定理使其在图规模线性下可解，并为有序超时提供线性时间动态规划与代价界。

Abstract: Retaining language-model prefix states trades recomputation against storage time. Optimizing each cached block independently can overcount savings: a resident block is usable only when the required preceding prefix is also available. We introduce Prefix-Certificate Retention (PCR), an exact finite-trace formulation for static, grouped, reset-on-access timeouts. Usable-prefix rewards become nodes whose prerequisites are timeout thresholds and preceding hit certificates. The resulting maximum-weight closure reduces to one minimum cut, with graph size linear in the number of block lookups and timeout choices. A breakpoint theorem extends the construction to all nonnegative timeouts without discretization error. We also derive a linear-time-in-grid-size dynamic program for ordered timeouts and bounds that certify the cost of this restriction. Exhaustive small-instance checks and chronological replay of 39,632 public Mooncake requests validate the formulation. On the fixed grid, ordered timeouts attain the unrestricted training optimum in 118 of 120 trace-grouping-price cases. Heterogeneous retention improves several held-out memory-time tradeoffs, but finer training optimization does not uniformly improve transfer. The contribution is a tractable optimization model and an auditable benchmark for retention policies; the experiments measure usable prefix blocks and storage time, not GPU latency.

</details>


### [258] [Tailoring the Quantization Space for 1-Bit KV Cache Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03027)
*Minsoo Cheong,Donghyun Son,Sungjoo Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TaSQ 通过查询引导的通道加权、跨头归一化和协方差感知的通道分组来定制向量量化目标空间，在 1-bit 极端压缩下实现更优的 KV cache 压缩，兼顾推理稳定性与serving效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV cache 成为主要内存瓶颈，压力集中在内存容量与带宽上。向量量化（VQ）是激进的 KV cache 压缩手段，但现有 VQ 方法在 1-bit 区间性能严重退化：每个码本需用有限质心表示更多通道，码本容量利用率难以保证。

Method: 提出 TaSQ，对 VQ 的目标空间进行定制化改造，包含三项技术：查询引导的通道加权（query-guided channel weighting）、跨头归一化（cross-head normalization）、协方差感知的通道分组（covariance-aware channel grouping），以更好反映缓存激活的误差敏感性与统计结构。这些变换与 RoPE 兼容，并可合并进投影权重和码本，从而保留传统 VQ 查表结构，serving 开销可忽略。

Result: 在通用任务、长链思维推理（long-chain-of-thought reasoning）和长上下文检索基准上，TaSQ 持续优于现有低比特 KV cache VQ 基线，并保持推理稳定性。在单张 RTX 6000 Ada GPU 上，其 SGLang 实现相较 BF16 基线支持最高 14 倍更大的批大小，峰值吞吐提升 1.87 倍。

Conclusion: TaSQ 通过面向误差敏感性与统计结构的目标空间变换，解决了 1-bit 极端 VQ 压缩下的性能退化问题，在精度与效率上均取得显著收益，且与现有 VQ 查表结构和 RoPE 兼容，具备实际部署价值。

Abstract: The key-value (KV) cache becomes a major memory bottleneck in long-context LLM inference, placing substantial pressure on memory capacity and bandwidth. To mitigate this bottleneck, vector quantization (VQ) has emerged as a promising approach for aggressive KV cache compression. However, existing VQ methods degrade substantially in the 1-bit regime. At such extreme compression, each codebook must represent a larger group of channels with a limited set of centroids, making effective use of its capacity increasingly challenging. To address this, we introduce $\textbf{TaSQ}$, which tailors the VQ target space by combining query-guided channel weighting, cross-head normalization, and covariance-aware channel grouping to better reflect the error sensitivity and statistical structure of cached activations. Since these transforms are RoPE-compatible and can be easily merged into projection weights and codebooks, TaSQ preserves the conventional VQ lookup structure and adds negligible serving overhead. Across general, long-chain-of-thought reasoning, and long-context retrieval benchmarks, TaSQ consistently outperforms existing low-bit KV cache VQ baselines while preserving reasoning stability. On a single RTX 6000 Ada GPU, its SGLang implementation supports up to $14\times$ larger batch sizes and achieves $1.87\times$ higher peak throughput compared to the BF16 baseline.

</details>


### [259] [No-Free-Graph: Learning When Multimodal Data Should Be Graphified](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02768)
*Zekai Chen,Kai Hu,YuXin Zeng,Xunkai Li,Xun Wu,Yinlin Zhu,Zhengyu Wu,Xu Wang,Rong-Hua Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出应把"图构建"视为基于预期效用的选择性决策，而非默认预处理；并给出预构建评估框架MAG-SCOUT，在生成完整拓扑前判断引入关系结构是否有益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态图学习研究多聚焦于图的构建与优化，却忽视了一个更根本的问题：对给定数据集和任务，是否应引入额外的关系结构。实证表明"图化"（graphification）并非稳定有益，有时提升显著，有时收益有限甚至为负。因此需要一种在构建完整拓扑前即可评估收益的机制。

Method: 提出MAG-SCOUT预构建图评估框架：先采集有限的关系证据（relational evidence），分析其对特定任务的潜在贡献，再估计图化的预期效用并结合构建成本，从而做出"构建或跳过"（build-or-skip）决策。

Result: 在六个多模态数据集、三类下游任务和多种图构建器上的实验表明，MAG-SCOUT能有效识别何时应引入图结构；在预先设定的下限约束下，节省了33.1%的任务宏观（task-macro）图工作量，同时保留了96.7%的留出正收益质量（positive-gain mass）。

Conclusion: 图构建不应被视为默认的预处理步骤，而应作为基于预期效用的选择性决策；MAG-SCOUT通过有限关系证据的效用与成本评估，实现高效、可靠的图化决策。

Abstract: Multimodal graph learning has recently emerged as an effective paradigm for in corporating inter-entity relationships into multimodal representations. Existing studies have made substantial progress on how to construct and optimize graphs, but rarely consider a more fundamental question: whether additional relational structures should be introduced for a given dataset and task. Through empirical studies across diverse datasets, tasks, and graph constructors, we reveal that graphification is not consistently beneficial: introducing relational structures can provide substantial improvements in some cases, while offering limited or even negative gains. This observation motivates a new perspective that graph construction should be treated as a selective decision based on its expected utility rather than a default preprocessing step. To address this issue, we propose MAG-SCOUT, a pre-construction graph assessment framework that estimates whether introducing graph structures is beneficial before generating the complete topology. MAG-SCOUT collects limited relational evidence, analyzes its potential taskspecific contribution, and estimates the expected utility of graphification together with construction cost to make a build-or-skip decision. Extensive experiments across six multimodal datasets, three downstream tasks, and diverse graph constructors demonstrate that MAG-SCOUT effectively identifies when graph structures should be introduced, saving 33.1% of task-macro graph work while retaining 96.7% of held-out positive-gain mass under the pre-registered floor.

</details>


### [260] [Adaptive Second-Order Solvers for Fast Stochastic Diffusion Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03034)
*Ella Kemperman,Luca Ambrogioni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于比例-积分（PI）步长控制的扩散模型自适应求解器，并验证其可聚合为固定离散化schedule；在图像和语言数据上，固定schedule与PI自适应求解器在匹配NFE下均能提升采样质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型依赖时间离散化的数值求解器，采样成本与质量之间存在权衡。然而逆向过程的计算难度沿采样轨迹和不同数据分布而变化，因此离散化选择十分关键。现有扩散自适应方法仅响应当前误差，缺乏对误差历史的利用，步长调整不够平滑。

Method: 将比例-积分（PI）步长控制引入扩散采样，并配合所提出的扩散噪声归一化误差估计器；PI求解器同时纳入当前误差与历史误差以实现更平滑的步长自适应。进一步发现逐样本轨迹具有共享结构，可聚合为一个固定schedule，保留自适应采样的大部分收益。在自然图像和语言数据集上，以匹配NFE下的FID（图像）和困惑度（语言）为指标，与常用随机求解器及schedule对比（含EDM schedule、entropy schedule、EDM-churn等）。

Result: 图像任务中，固定离散化配合随机Heun采样器时质量优于常用EDM schedule，在低NFE下配合EDM-churn采样器同样更优；PI自适应求解器FID优于多数随机与自适应baseline，但低NFE下不及EDM-churn。语言扩散任务中，求解器在低到中等NFE下困惑度优于EDM与entropy schedule，但token熵较低。逐样本自适应性收益与问题相关：在1D玩具示例中收益显著，在图像与语言数据上仅边际，平均schedule有时甚至优于PI自适应求解器。代码已开源。

Conclusion: PI步长控制能带来更平滑的扩散采样步长自适应，其逐样本轨迹可聚合为具有竞争力的固定schedule。固定离散化在图像采样上优于EDM schedule，PI自适应求解器在图像FID与语言困惑度上表现良好，但逐样本自适应性的收益高度依赖具体问题。

Abstract: Diffusion models rely on numerical solvers requiring time-discretization, which has a large influence on the tradeoff between sampling cost and quality. However, the computational difficulty of the reverse process varies along the sampling trajectory and across data distributions, making the choice of discretization important. We adapt proportional-integral (PI) step-size control to diffusion, using our diffusion noise-normalised error estimator. Unlike existing adaptive methods in diffusion that respond only to the current error, the PI solver also incorporates the previous error, yielding smoother step adaptation. We further show that these per-sample trajectories exhibit shared structure and can be aggregated into a fixed schedule that retains much of the benefit of adaptive sampling. We evaluate both approaches on natural-image and language datasets, in terms of quality, measured by FID at a matched number of neural network evaluations (NFE), comparing them with widely used stochastic solvers and schedules. For images, our fixed discretization outperforms the commonly used EDM schedule in terms of sample quality when used with the stochastic Heun sampler, and with the EDM-churn sampler at low NFE. Additionally, our PI adaptive solver obtains better FID than most stochastic and adaptive baselines, although it does not beat the EDM-churn sampler at low NFE. Moreover, we find our solver outperforms both the EDM and the entropy schedule on language diffusion at low-to-medium NFE in terms of perplexity, with the drawback of lower token entropy. Lastly, we find that the benefit of per-sample adaptivity is problem-dependent. It is highly beneficial in 1D toy examples, while only marginal for image and language data, where the average schedule sometimes even outperforms the PI-adaptive solver. Code is available at https://github.com/ellakemperman/adaptive-second-order-diffusion-solvers

</details>


### [261] [Nearly Optimal Fixed-Confidence Best-Arm Identification with 1-Bit Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02771)
*Khang Luong,Dinh Thai Son,Hoang Ta,Hung The Tran,Tuan Quang Dam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究严格1比特反馈下的固定置信度最佳臂识别问题，提出基于随机阈值查询与截断尾积分恒等式的时间一致1比特均值估计原语，并构建两种候选-挑战者算法：固定截断算法给出(ε,δ)-PAC保证，分阶段自适应截断算法实现间隙自适应样本复杂度；同时证明有限方差1比特反馈的对数惩罚是内在的，下界与分阶段算法主阶匹配（至多相差log log因子）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究在每轮仅能获得1比特信息（奖励是否属于查询集合）的严格反馈约束下进行最佳臂识别。此类设定下无法直接进行经验均值估计，截断操作不可避免，因此需要新的估计原语与算法设计，并刻画有限方差1比特反馈带来的固有限制。

Method: 1) 提出时间一致的1比特均值估计原语，基于随机阈值查询与截断尾积分恒等式；2) 将该原语嵌入候选-挑战者最佳臂识别框架；3) 设计固定截断算法，提供简单的anytime (ε,δ)-PAC保证；4) 设计分阶段自适应截断算法，将截断水平与当前分辨率匹配，获得间隙自适应样本复杂度；5) 证明K臂最坏情况下的信息论下界。

Result: 固定截断算法给出简单的anytime (ε,δ)-PAC保证；分阶段自适应截断算法实现间隙自适应样本复杂度；下界表明有限方差1比特反馈导致的对数惩罚是内在的，且与分阶段算法的主阶依赖匹配，仅相差低阶log log因子。

Conclusion: 有限方差严格1比特反馈环境下，最佳臂识别的对数惩罚不可避免；所提分阶段自适应截断算法在样本复杂度上达到近乎最优的主阶性能，验证了该惩罚的紧致性。

Abstract: We study fixed-confidence best-arm identification under strict 1-bit feedback constraints. At each round, the learner selects an arm and a query set, and receives only a single bit indicating whether the sampled reward belongs to that set. We consider a distribution-free finite-variance setting with arm-wise localization, where direct empirical mean estimation is no longer available and clipping becomes unavoidable. We first formulate a time-uniform 1-bit mean-estimation primitive based on randomized threshold queries and a clipped tail-integral identity. We then embed this primitive into candidate-challenger best-arm identification algorithms. A fixed-clipping algorithm gives a simple anytime $(ε,δ)$-PAC guarantee, while a phased adaptive-clipping algorithm matches the clipping level to the current resolution and yields a gap-adaptive sample complexity. We also prove a $K$-arm worst-case information-theoretic lower bound showing that the logarithmic penalty caused by finite-variance 1-bit feedback is intrinsic. This bound matches the leading dependence of the phased algorithm up to lower-order $\log\log$ factors.

</details>


### [262] [LatticeSMC: Where to Spend Inference-Time Compute in Chunked Sequence Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02774)
*Xuanchen Wang,Heng Wang,Weidong Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出预算匹配的分块引导框架与LatticeSMC采样器，在块索引×去噪步二维格点上做Feynman-Kac重采样，在同等算力下显著提升长序列生成的对齐与提示依从性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长序列生成器（音乐、动作、视频）逐块生成、块内迭代去噪，而奖励定义在整段序列上；现有推理时引导方法（best-of-N、Feynman-Kac跨去噪步引导、流式跨块剪枝）每次只作用于单一维度，且常在不匹配的算力或不同回报规则下比较，缺乏统一、公平的评测基准。

Method: 提出预算匹配的分块引导（budget-matched chunked steering）设定；定义块索引与去噪步二维格点上的Feynman-Kac模型，据此推导LatticeSMC采样器。两个"套叠"（telescoping）结论保证设计精确性：(1) 对块可加奖励，两个维度诱导出相同权重，故应在前瞻代价最低处重采样；(2) 对终末奖励，任意前缀得分可定义精确的中间势函数，使可前缀评估的奖励成为无需估计、无需额外去噪调用的"twist"。LatticeSMC在块边界依势重采样，当评分免费时块内也重采样，输出加权样本或最优粒子。

Result: 在匹配算力下：音乐到舞蹈扩散任务中节拍对齐从0.234提升至0.441（best-of-N为0.354）；40秒文本到音乐生成中提示依从性在32粒子时从0.470提升至0.560，同时保持留出集质量。在长程奖励上保持优势，60–77%的成对人工比较中被偏好。

Conclusion: 承诺强度应跟随当前势函数所含信息量，前瞻的价值可由未来奖励的集合内可预测性来预测；统一的预算匹配视角使不同引导轴可公平比较并组合。

Abstract: Long-form generators for music, motion and video produce sequences chunk by chunk, with each chunk generated by iterative denoising while rewards are defined over the full sequence. Existing inference-time steering methods typically act on one axis at a time: best-of-N at the end, Feynman-Kac steering across denoising steps, or streaming pruning across chunks, and are often compared under unmatched compute or different return rules. We introduce budget-matched chunked steering and propose LatticeSMC, a sampler derived from a Feynman-Kac model on the two-dimensional lattice of chunk index and denoising step. Two telescoping results make its design exact: for chunk-additive rewards, the two axes induce identical weights, so resampling should occur where lookahead is cheapest; for terminal rewards, any prefix score defines an exact intermediate potential, making prefix-evaluable rewards twists with no estimation or extra denoiser calls. LatticeSMC resamples on these potentials at chunk boundaries and, when scoring is free, within chunks, returning either a weighted draw or the best particle. Under matched compute, on music-to-dance diffusion and 40-second text-to-music generation, it raises beat alignment from 0.234 to 0.441 (best-of-N: 0.354) and prompt adherence from 0.470 to 0.560 at 32 particles, while preserving held-out quality. It also retains its advantage on long-range rewards and is preferred by human raters in 60-77 percent of pairwise comparisons. Finally, we show that commitment strength should follow the information in the current potential, while the value of lookahead is predicted by the within-set predictability of future reward.

</details>


### [263] [Controlling Polar Exposure to Delay Memorization in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02780)
*Xuanchen Wang,Heng Wang,Weidong Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Quality-Gated De-whitening (QGD) 控制器，通过保留快速极坐标更新前缀并逐步恢复固定增益动量来延迟样本记忆，配合 Copy-Budgeted Selection (CBS) 在 CIFAR-10 子集上将有用泛化区间扩大 8.32 倍、复制降低 75.9%，FID 从 79.37 降至 75.56。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在开始复制训练样本前即可达到可用样本质量，但快速优化会通过加速样本特定拟合而压缩这一泛化窗口。作者希望研究该效应并寻找延迟记忆、扩展质量-复制权衡空间的方法。

Method: 通过更新几何研究该效应，提出 QGD 控制器：保留快速极坐标更新前缀，逐步恢复固定增益动量，并实现结合质量门控、有界衰减包络与因果复制反馈。理论层面用随机特征分析分离协方差控制、曲率均衡和幅度控制的记忆时钟，在对齐谱假设下给出有限曝光条件，证明固定增益尾部可恢复与数据集规模成正比的延迟。同时提出 CBS，对冻结检查点家族做同步二项校准，再对发布检查点进行独立评估。

Result: 在 2,000 张 CIFAR-10 子集上，QGD 在保持极坐标基线质量到达时间的同时将有用区间扩大 8.32 倍，并将常见检查点复制减少 75.9%。在相同校准与独立质量评估下，QGD 达到 FID 75.56，而同选择器的 SGD 为 79.37。曝光匹配对照、独立检测器审计以及在流匹配和舞蹈生成上的迁移验证了该方法。

Conclusion: 自适应曝光控制是改善质量-复制权衡的实用手段。QGD 通过延迟复制并维持质量提升，在多种模型与任务上展现了有效性。

Abstract: Diffusion models can reach useful sample quality before copying training examples, but fast optimization can compress this generalization window by accelerating sample-specific fitting. We investigate this effect through update geometry and propose Quality-Gated De-whitening (QGD), a controller that retains a fast polar-update prefix and progressively restores fixed-gain momentum. Our random-feature analysis separates covariance-controlled, curvature-equalized and amplitude-controlled memorization clocks. Under aligned spectral assumptions, it establishes a finite-exposure condition under which a fixed-gain tail recovers a delay proportional to dataset size. QGD implements this principle with a confirmed quality gate, a bounded decay envelope and causal copy feedback. Immediate switching is the conservative limit; gradual control balances delayed copying against continued quality improvement. We pair QGD with Copy-Budgeted Selection (CBS), which applies simultaneous binomial calibration to a frozen checkpoint family, followed by a fresh evaluation of the released checkpoint. On 2,000-image CIFAR-10 subsets, QGD preserves the polar baseline's quality-arrival time while expanding its useful interval by 8.32x and reducing common-checkpoint copying by 75.9%. With identical calibration and independent quality evaluation, QGD achieves FID 75.56 versus 79.37 for SGD with the same selector. Exposure-matched controls, independent detector audits and transfer to flow matching and dance generation support adaptive exposure control as a practical way to improve the quality-copying tradeoff.

</details>


### [264] [Predicting and Repairing Merge Collapse in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03199)
*Jungseob Lee,Seungyoon Lee,Sugyeong Eo,Hyeonseok Moon,Jaehyung Seo,Heuiseok Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现任务向量的一个统计量（跨专家任务向量的方差，即"干扰度"）可预测模型合并的崩溃，并据此提出修复算子PRISM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从共享基座微调的多个大模型可通过平均任务向量进行合并，但某些合并会导致性能远低于基座模型，且现有合并算子评估前无法给出预警，只能在评估后才发现崩溃。因此需要一种能在合并前预判崩溃并加以修复的方法。

Method: 作者提出以跨专家任务向量的方差作为"干扰度"度量，该方差等于平均过程所消除的功率。在噪声模型下，合并引入的扰动随合并系数与干扰度增大，由此得到合并前评分。并提出PRISM算子：先对任务向量求平均，再按每层干扰度设定的阈值对该层进行软阈值处理。仅在评分超过阈值时应用PRISM，低于阈值时保留普通平均。

Result: 在来自四个模型家族的二十二种合并配置上，只有破坏性合并的评分超过阈值；而符号冲突统计量（现有算子的常见目标）反而具有反向预测性。预先预测十四次合并的结果，其中十二次正确，包括因持续预训练越过阈值的专家对所产生的破坏性结果。无数据、无调参条件下，PRISM使所有五次破坏性合并保持高于阈值（在基座模型评估噪声范围内），而普通平均至少低14.4分或完全崩溃。

Conclusion: 任务向量的干扰度统计量既能预测合并崩溃，也能校准其修复。据此提出的PRISM可在无需数据与调参的情况下有效避免破坏性合并，且可与普通平均结合使用：超阈值时用PRISM，低于阈值时用普通平均，覆盖全部十五种无害合并。

Abstract: Large language models fine-tuned from a shared base can be merged by averaging their task vectors, but some merges collapse far below the base model, and common merge operators give no warning before evaluation. We show that one statistic of the specialists' task vectors both predicts this collapse and calibrates its repair. The power that averaging removes equals the variance of the task vectors across specialists, our measure of interference. Under a working noise model, the disturbance that a merge injects grows with the merge coefficient and with interference, yielding a pre-merge score. In our experiments on twenty-two merge configurations from four model families, only destructive merges exceed a threshold on this score. We find that statistics of sign conflict between specialists, a common target of existing merge operators, are anti-predictive. We then predicted the outcomes of fourteen merges before evaluating them, and twelve predictions were correct, including the destructive outcome of a specialist pair pushed past the threshold by continued pretraining. To address this collapse, we introduce PRISM, an operator that averages the task vectors first and then soft-thresholds each layer at a level set by the layer's interference. Without data or tuning, PRISM keeps all five destructive merges above the threshold within evaluation noise of the base model, where plain averaging falls at least 14.4 points below it or collapses entirely. We apply PRISM only above the threshold and keep the plain average for merges below it, which include all fifteen harmless ones. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/PRISM.

</details>


### [265] [Efficient Memory Crystallization for Graph Learning under Non-Stationary Distribution Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02795)
*Yue Hou,Ruomei Liu,Yingke Su,Junran Wu,Ke Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出高效记忆结晶（EMC），一个免训练的测试时框架，通过闭式解的记忆导向分布匹配目标，将每个到来的图域蒸馏为紧凑的语义记忆，从而在持续协变量漂移下实现高效的图模型跨域适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实系统中的深度图学习模型常面临非平稳环境，图分布随时间持续漂移。现有方法依赖训练辅助生成模块来合成记忆图以进行跨域适应，计算开销大，且在长期分布漂移下扩展性差。作者认为无需"生成"记忆，而可以"结晶"记忆，从而以更经济的方式实现适应。

Method: 提出 Efficient Memory Crystallization (EMC)，一种免训练的测试时框架：1）通过记忆导向分布匹配目标的闭式解，将每个到来的图域蒸馏为紧凑且语义忠实的记忆，消除持续协变量漂移下的冗余域信息；2）通过状态演化记忆（state-evolving memories）建模域间依赖；3）给出理论上更紧的泛化误差界。

Result: 在非平稳分布漂移的图数据上，EMC 性能优于当前最优基线；相较近期竞争方法，平均运行时间减少 87.4%，GPU 显存消耗减少 92.4%。

Conclusion: EMC 通过"结晶"而非"生成"记忆的方式，在免训练条件下兼顾泛化性与适应性，使大规模持续图适应变得切实可行，显著提升效率并降低资源开销。

Abstract: Deep graph learning models deployed in real-world systems often need to cope with non-stationary environments, where the underlying graph distribution drifts continually over time. Prevailing solutions rely on training auxiliary generative modules to synthesize memory graphs for cross-domain adaptation, which incurs substantial computational overhead and scales poorly under prolonged distribution shifts. We argue that a more economical path exists: rather than generating memory, one can crystallize it. To this end, we propose Efficient Memory Crystallization (EMC), a training-free test-time framework that distills each incoming graph domain into a compact, semantically faithful memory through a closed-form solution to a memory-oriented distribution-matching objective, thereby eliminating redundant domain information under continual covariate shifts. To preserve both generalizability and adaptability as the model traverses a long sequence of target domains, EMC further models inter-domain dependencies through state-evolving memories and admits a theoretically grounded, tighter generalization error bound than direct adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of EMC over state-of-the-art baselines on graphs under non-stationary distribution shifts, while reducing average runtime by 87.4% and GPU memory consumption by 92.4% relative to the recent competitor, making continual graph adaptation practical at scale.

</details>


### [266] [AdaStep: Adaptive Step Credit Weighting for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03223)
*Xin Wang,Wenhao Wu,Menghao Zhang,Zhi Wang,Kun Shao,Jian Luan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AdaStep，一种自适应步级信用权重方法，通过收缩系数平衡轨迹级与步级优势信号，无需额外critic或采样即可提升长时程LLM智能体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程LLM智能体通常仅使用稀疏的结果奖励训练，轨迹级目标过于粗糙，无法区分单个决策的贡献；而步级信用分配虽提供更细粒度的监督，但其估计不可靠，因为观测回报还取决于后续动作、环境转移与轨迹长度。

Method: 将步级信用权重建模为潜在步级优势的均方误差估计问题；在显式条件采样假设下，推导出最优的逐状态收缩系数。该系数具有信噪比（信号-总方差）解释：当回报变化可归因于所选动作时保留局部信用，当变化由下游随机性主导时抑制局部信用。方法仅需轻量标量计算，不需要critic、额外rollout或额外模型推理。

Result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld三个环境上，使用三种模型骨干进行实验，相比基线均取得一致性提升，且计算成本低。

Conclusion: AdaStep通过可控的逐状态收缩系数实现可靠的步级信用分配，兼顾细粒度监督与估计稳定性，是一种轻量、通用且有效的长时程LLM智能体训练改进方案。

Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents are typically trained with sparse outcome rewards, making trajectory-level objectives too coarse to distinguish the contribution of individual decisions. Step-level credit assignment provides finer-grained supervision, but its estimates can be unreliable because observed returns also depend on subsequent actions, environment transitions, and trajectory length. We propose AdaStep, an Adaptive Step-credit weighting method that controls how strongly each group-derived local advantage modifies the trajectory-level signal. We formulate this weighting as a mean-squared-error estimation problem for the latent step advantage and, under an explicit conditional sampling assumption, derive an optimal per-state shrinkage coefficient. The coefficient admits a signal-to-total-variance interpretation: it preserves local credit when return variation is attributable to the selected action and suppresses it when variation is dominated by downstream randomness. AdaStep requires only lightweight scalar computation, with no critic, additional rollouts, or extra model inference. Experiments with three model backbones on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld show consistent improvements over baselines at low computational cost.

</details>


### [267] [Muon Learns Facts Better: Understanding the Role of Spectral Orthogonalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02798)
*Xuheng Li,Qiwei Di,Yuan Cao,Quanquan Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过可解的事实回忆模型，从机理角度揭示了 Muon 优化器（谱梯度流）的谱正交化如何重塑特征学习动力学，显著缩小主体与关系依赖信息的学习时间差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon 优化器对矩阵值更新施加谱正交化，在大规模神经网络训练中表现优异，但其在特征学习中的机理尚不清楚。本文旨在从理论上理解谱正交化如何影响特征学习的动态过程。

Method: 采用可解的事实回忆模型：一个事实将每个"主体-关系"对映射到一个答案，线性 Transformer 学习恢复该映射所需的主体依赖和关系依赖信息。分别用梯度流(GF)、谱梯度流(Spectral GF，即 Muon 的连续时间极限)和 Sign GF（Adam 的连续时间极限）优化模型，并刻画主体与关系依赖分量达到目标精度所需的学习时间。

Result: 当主体数 S 超过关系数 R 时，GF 先学关系依赖信息、后学主体依赖信息，出现特征分离阶段。GF 的学习时间比为 Θ̃(√(S/R))，而谱 GF 将其降至 Θ̃(1)。固定 S、R 时，GF 下主体与关系依赖误差随训练时间 T 以 1/(T log T) 衰减，而谱 GF 下以 exp(-poly(T)) 衰减。此外，GF 与谱 GF 在 token 嵌入的正交变换下等变，Sign GF 不等变，不同正交嵌入可能导致无特征分离、大特征分离阶段甚至学习顺序反转。

Conclusion: 研究给出了谱正交化从根本上重塑特征学习动力学的机理视角：Muon 的谱正交化通过使学习过程在正交变换下等变并平衡不同依赖分量的学习速度，显著缩短主体-关系特征分离阶段，加速收敛。

Abstract: The Muon optimizer applies spectral orthogonalization to matrix-valued updates and has shown strong performance in large-scale neural network training, yet the mechanisms of this transformation in feature learning remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate this question through a tractable factual-recall model, where a fact maps each subject-relation pair to an answer, and a linear transformer learns the subject- and relation-dependent information required to recover this mapping. The transformer is optimized with gradient flow (GF), spectral GF, or Sign GF, which are continuous-time limits of gradient descent, Muon, and Adam, respectively. Prior studies (Nichani et al., 2025) have shown that when the number of subjects exceeds the number of relations, GF learns relation-dependent information before subject-dependent information, producing a feature-separation phase during training. We characterize this separation with the learning times when the subject- and relation-dependent components of the prediction reach a target accuracy. With $S$ subjects and $R$ relations, GF has a learning-time ratio of $\widetildeΘ(\sqrt{S/R})$, whereas Spectral GF reduces this ratio to $\widetildeΘ(1)$. In addition, for fixed $S$ and $R$, the subject- and relation-dependent errors decay as $1/(T\log T)$ in training time $T$ under GF, but as $\exp(-\mathrm{poly}(T))$ under spectral GF. Finally, we show that GF and spectral GF are equivariant under orthogonal transformations of the token embeddings, whereas Sign GF is not: Different orthonormal embeddings can potentially produce no feature separation, a large feature-separation phase, or even a reversed learning order. These results provide a mechanistic view of how spectral orthogonalization can fundamentally reshape feature-learning dynamics.

</details>


### [268] [Gated Slot Attention-2: Two-Sided Associative Memory Correction in Linear Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02816)
*Ruijie Li,Shengnan Ding,Weimin Zhang,Derick Tang,Zhanpeng Zeng,Qinsong Zeng,Ming Chen,Jiaxi Hu,Yuxuan Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 GSA2，将 Gated Oja Rule-2 的键侧校正与 Gated Delta Rule-2 的值侧校正通过共享潜在槽结合，并推导分块并行训练算法，在保持线性时间与常数内存的同时超越强线性注意力基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性注意力虽高效，但其固定大小的循环记忆难以有效管理。已有两条改进方向：delta-rule 变体用于精确校正键关联的值，以及 Gated Slot Attention 等槽式结构分两阶段建模键与值记忆。作者观察到这两条路线互补：delta 规则提供有效的记忆校正，而两阶段结构天然支持在关联的两侧分别操作。

Method: 作者提出 Gated Oja Rule 用于键侧校正，并通过解耦的擦除与写入控制扩展为 Gated Oja Rule-2；进而提出 Gated Slot Attention-2（GSA2），通过共享潜在槽将 Gated Oja Rule-2（键侧校正）与 Gated Delta Rule-2（值侧校正）结合，并推导出硬件高效的分块（chunkwise）算法以支持并行训练。

Result: 实验表明，GSA2 在多个基准上持续优于强线性注意力基线，同时保持线性时间的序列建模和常数内存的循环解码。

Conclusion: GSA2 通过融合键侧 Oja 规则校正与值侧 delta 规则校正的互补机制，实现了更优的线性注意力记忆管理，兼顾性能与效率。

Abstract: Linear attention models have emerged as efficient alternatives to standard attention, but effectively managing their fixed-size recurrent memory remains challenging. To improve memory, recent work has explored two distinct directions: delta-rule variants for precise correction of values associated with keys, and slot-based architectures such as Gated Slot Attention for modeling key and value memories in two stages. We observe that these directions are complementary--the delta rule provides effective memory correction, while the two-stage structure provides a natural way to operate on both sides of an association. Building on this insight, we introduce a new Gated Oja Rule for key-side correction and extend it with decoupled erase and write control to obtain Gated Oja Rule-2. We then introduce Gated Slot Attention-2 (GSA2), which combines Gated Oja Rule-2 for key-side correction with Gated Delta Rule-2 for value-side correction through shared latent slots. We further derive a hardware-efficient chunkwise algorithm for parallel training. Experiments demonstrate that GSA2 consistently improves over strong linear-attention baselines across benchmarks while retaining linear-time sequence modeling and constant-memory recurrent decoding.

</details>


### [269] [Adaptive Spectral-Koopman Dynamics Modeling for Temporal Domain Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02822)
*Tengxue Zhang,Yu Ke,Yang Shu,Chenchen Sun,Yisheng An,Chenjuan Guo,Bin Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 AdaSpecK，一个结合谱正则化 Koopman 动力学建模与自适应上下文提取的框架，用于解决时序域泛化（TDG）中噪声过拟合与模型复杂不可解释的问题，在八个基准上取得 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实流式数据存在随时间变化的分布偏移，TDG 需应对。现有方法要么在数据空间容易过拟合域特定噪声，要么在参数空间过于复杂、可解释性差。论文旨在弥合这两类缺陷。

Method: 1) 谱正则化 Koopman 动力学建模：在隐空间施加谱感知滤波，提取去噪的低频轨迹，并学习 Koopman 算子以线性化空间建模系统动力学，缓解不规则采样域的噪声拟合。2) 上下文感知异质模式提取机制：采用目标条件注意力模块关注不同历史窗口，生成动态的、面向目标的历史摘要；再由当前演化模式构建环境签名，通过学习的路由器自适应判断过去上下文中哪些部分对预测最有信息量。

Result: 在八个涵盖分类与回归的多样基准上，AdaSpecK 达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。

Conclusion: AdaSpecK 通过谱-Koopman 框架与自适应上下文提取，在提升时序域泛化性能的同时兼顾去噪与可解释性，验证了方法的有效性与通用性。

Abstract: Temporal Domain Generalization (TDG) has emerged to address real-world streaming data with distribution shifts over time. However, existing methods are either prone to overfitting to domain-specific noise in the data space or become overly complex and less interpretable in the parameter space. To bridge these gaps, we propose \textbf{AdaSpecK}, a spectral-Koopman framework with adaptive context extraction for TDG. To mitigate noise fitting to irregularly sampled domains, we introduce spectral-regularized Koopman dynamics modeling, which applies spectral-aware filtering in the latent space to extract denoised low-frequency trajectories and learn a Koopman operator to model the system dynamics in a linearized space. To model complex historical environments under non-stationarity, we design a context-informed heterogeneous pattern extraction mechanism. Specifically, we employ a target-conditioned attention module to attend to distinct past windows, producing a dynamic, target-specific historical summary. By constructing an environmental signature from the current evolutionary pattern, our model adaptively perceives which aspects of the past context are most informative for future prediction via a learned router. Extensive experiments on eight diverse classification and regression benchmarks demonstrate that AdaSpecK achieves state-of-the-art performance. The code and datasets are available at \href{}{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Ada-Spec-K}.

</details>


### [270] [All Work And No Play Makes Jack a Dull Boy: Understanding and Preventing Catastrophic Strategy Collapse in RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02835)
*Qiyuan Huang,Tianshi Xu,Meng Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文揭示RLVR训练中GRPO类算法的后期崩溃源于有效策略容量收缩，提出MEI预警指标和Mesh Learning方法，在多个基准上显著超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO类算法在LLM的RLVR后训练中会出现严重的后期崩溃。作者通过prompt探测证明这并非良性的策略剪枝，而是有效策略容量的有害收缩，导致不同推理策略越来越难以获取，亟需机理层面的解释与防治手段。

Method: 通过轨迹级策略更新交互定义策略，构建结合优化动态与信息理论的统一理论框架，证明主要RLVR目标会逐步将概率质量集中到单一策略上，而维持任务准确率需要最小策略容量；据此推导出Mirrored Entanglement Index (MEI)作为轻量级在线预警信号，并提出Mesh Learning方法，暴露多种推理策略并防止单一策略主导优化。

Result: 在AIME26、AIME25、MATH-500、GPQA和LiveCodeBench上，Mesh Learning在Qwen和Phi模型系列中一致优于强基线，增益分别最高达13.4个百分点和11.5个百分点。

Conclusion: 策略保持（strategy preservation）是稳定RLVR的关键原则，理论分析与实证结果共同支撑这一结论。

Abstract: During post-training of large language models (LLMs) with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), GRPO-style algorithms can exhibit severe late-stage collapse. Prompt-based probing reveals that this is not benign strategic pruning, but a harmful contraction of effective strategy capacity that makes distinct reasoning strategies increasingly inaccessible. To characterize this phenomenon, we define strategies through trajectory-level policy-update interactions and develop a unified theoretical framework combining optimization dynamics and information theory. We prove that major RLVR objectives progressively concentrate probability mass onto a single strategy, while sustaining nontrivial task accuracy requires a minimum strategy capacity. The conflict between these two results provides a mechanistic explanation for catastrophic collapse. We further derive the {Mirrored Entanglement Index (MEI)} as a lightweight online warning signal. To prevent collapse, we propose \textbf{Mesh Learning}, which exposes multiple reasoning strategies and prevents any single strategy from dominating optimization. Across AIME26, AIME25, MATH-500, GPQA, and LiveCodeBench, Mesh Learning consistently outperforms strong baselines across Qwen and Phi model families, with gains of up to 13.4 pp and 11.5 pp, respectively. These results establish strategy preservation as a key principle for stable RLVR. Code is available at https://github.com/Ayanami-0123/Open-Mesh-Learning.

</details>


### [271] [Divergence controls entropy in distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03529)
*Nicolas Zucchet,Scott W. Linderman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文从熵的角度切入，研究蒸馏中学生模型熵如何由数据与散度决定：前向KL会使学生熵高于教师熵，反向KL则压低熵，散度相当于隐式熵正则化器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蒸馏已成为大语言模型训练的核心手段，但其性质尚未被充分理解，尤其是蒸馏目标中数据与散度如何影响学生模型的行为缺乏理论刻画，作者希望用熵这一视角填补这一空白。

Method: 作者采用信息论/熵的分析视角，对不同散度（前向KL、反向KL及其插值）下学生模型熵与教师熵的关系进行理论推导，并将交叉熵训练作为前向KL的特例纳入统一分析；同时在预训练与监督微调中做定量验证，对比on-policy蒸馏与token级反向KL的作用，并以自蒸馏为案例考察散度超参的选取。

Result: 理论上证明前向KL会把学生熵抬升到教师熵之上，并给出可定量验证的恒等式；反向KL则持续压低熵直到师生差距过大；两者插值在训练早期使熵平滑变化，而在收敛时发生突变。实验表明on-policy蒸馏的低熵来源于token级反向KL而非on-policy采样本身。

Conclusion: 散度实际上充当隐式熵正则化器，这一点在自蒸馏中最为明显：由于条件于特权信息会降低熵，表现最好的散度超参正是那些能够补偿这种熵降低的取值。

Abstract: Distillation has become a core primitive of large language model training, but its properties are not yet well understood. We take an entropic perspective, studying how the entropy of the student depends on the data and the divergence that define the distillation objective. We prove that forward KL inflates the entropy of the student above that of the teacher. Since cross-entropy training is a special case, this yields an identity that we verify quantitatively in pretraining and supervised finetuning. Other divergences come with no such guarantee: reverse KL deflates entropy until the gap between student and teacher gets too large, and interpolating between the two changes entropy smoothly early in training but abruptly at convergence. The lower entropy of on-policy distillation comes from token-level reverse KL, not from on-policy sampling. The divergence therefore acts as an implicit entropy regularizer, whose role is clearest in self-distillation: as conditioning on privileged information deflates entropy, the divergence hyperparameters that work best are those that compensate for it.

</details>


### [272] [Understanding Enrichment in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02846)
*Jinwoo Kim,Shraddha Barke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从数学上刻画了RLVR中"富集rollout"的修正问题：省略或截断重要性权重等价于隐性重加权奖励，并可用SMC权重修正将方差的指数累积缓和为加性累积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在奖励稀疏时，RLVR常借助提示或中间引导生成更多成功rollout，但这会使策略梯度产生偏差。现有方法要么忽略重要性权重修正，要么为避免高方差而截断权重，导致"修正富集rollout究竟得失为何"尚不清楚。

Method: 文章首先证明省略或截断修正等价于对定义奖励的隐式重加权，并将由此产生的梯度误差分解为尺度、旋转与方差三个成分以解释其不同影响；随后提出一种序列蒙特卡洛（SMC）权重修正机制，在稳定性与粒子次序假设下，把标准修正方差随样本长度的指数级累积缓和为加性累积；最后将该富集分析用于解释Qwen3-1.7B在OpenMathReasoning稀疏区间上的微调结果。

Result: 理论上给出了省略/截断修正的梯度误差分解，并提出可落地的SMC权重修正；实证上解释了富集（无论修正与否）如何在稀疏域中帮助避免崩溃，揭示了具体机制。

Conclusion: 论文的核心贡献并非断言修正或未修正的富集优于未富集RL，而是从一般意义上理解富集与修正如何影响训练，为RLVR中稀疏奖励下的引导使用提供理论解释。

Abstract: When rewards are sparse, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) often uses hints or intermediate guidance to generate more successful rollouts. This enrichment biases policy-gradient updates unless corrected via importance weights, but existing methods omit correction or truncate importance weights in order to avoid the high variance of correction. It thus remains unclear what exactly is gained or lost in RLVR by correcting enriched rollouts. We show, mathematically, that omitted or truncated correction implicitly reweights the defined reward, and we decompose the resulting gradient error into scale, rotation, and variance to explain their distinct effects on learning. To make correction practical, we develop a novel sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) weight correction mechanism that, under stability and particle-order assumptions, tempers the exponential compounding of standard correction variance over the length of a sample to an additive accumulation. We then apply our analysis of enrichment to interpreting the results of a fine-tune of Qwen3-1.7B on a sparse band of OpenMathReasoning, establishing a concrete mechanism of how enrichment, both corrected and uncorrected, helps avoid collapse in sparse domains. Our main contribution is to understand, in general, how enrichment and correction can affect training, as opposed to claiming that either mode of operation is superior to unenriched RL.

</details>


### [273] [Pivot-SD: Efficient Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03665)
*Seo Hyun Kim,Sunwoo Hong,Younwoo Choi,Chen-Hao Chao,Se-Young Yun,Rahul G. Krishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Pivot-SD：一种面向掩码扩散语言模型的离线自蒸馏框架，仅监督去噪过程中降低剩余掩码不确定性的高影响"关键承诺"（pivots），用200题×4采样即超越全序列SFT与等预算扩散RL基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型（dLMs）在复杂推理上可并行解码，但存在独特的信用分配难题：去噪中的少数承诺会大幅降低其余掩码位置的不确定性并主导响应走向。现有后训练方法（对最终文本训练或给整步分配奖励）未利用该信号，无法定位真正塑造响应的单个承诺。

Method: 提出Pivot-SD离线自蒸馏框架：以"信息增益"指标（衡量对剩余掩码位置不确定性的削减程度）筛选pivots；成功轨迹的pivots用交叉熵训练，失败轨迹的pivots用定向unlikelihood训练，失败轨迹其余部分保持不动。仅需200个问题、每条4次rollout。

Result: 在数学与代码基准上，Pivot-SD使LLaDA-8B-Instruct优于全序列SFT及预算匹配的扩散RL基线。

Conclusion: 将信用分配粒度从整条序列/整个去噪步细化到高影响token级别，是dLMs后训练的高效路径，且能以极低数据与采样成本取得增益。

Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLMs) offer a promising parallel alternative to autoregressive models for complex reasoning. However, they face a distinct credit-assignment challenge, since a few commitments during denoising sharply reduce the uncertainty over the remaining masked positions and shape much of the response.
