Most post-training recipes for dLMs do not use this signal to decide which tokens to train on: they typically train on the final text or assign rewards to whole denoising steps, rather than selecting the individual commitments that shape the response. We introduce Pivot-SD, an efficient offline self-distillation framework that supervises only these high-impact commitments (pivots). Pivot-SD selects pivots using an information-gain metric measuring uncertainty reduction over the remaining masked positions. Pivots from successful trajectories are trained with cross-entropy, and pivots from failed trajectories with targeted unlikelihood, leaving the rest of the failed trajectory untouched. Using only 200 questions and four rollouts each, Pivot-SD improves LLaDA-8B-Instruct over full-sequence SFT and budget-matched diffusion RL baselines across math and code benchmarks.

</details>


### [274] [Counterfactual Action Evaluation, Observation Bottlenecks, and Representation Geometry in Joint-Embedding Predictive World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02860)
*Arjun Subramanian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出低潜空间预测误差不能证明世界模型区分了自身动作的后果，提出沿"模拟器状态→栅格观测→目标嵌入→预测器输出"追踪同一干预的评估协议，在可控可形变物理测试台中揭示多重瓶颈：观测不可见、动作路径利用不足、表征几何集中、物理量不可辨识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型评估常以低潜空间预测误差或低MSE作为模型学到物理动力学的证据，但误差低并不等价于模型真正区分不同动作导致的后果。作者希望拆解"低误差"背后的成因，区分观测可见性、动作依赖、表征几何与物理量可辨识性等不同瓶颈，避免把不可见的动作效应或退化的表征空间误判为模型能力。

Method: 提出一种评估协议，对同一干预沿四个层级进行追踪：模拟器状态、栅格观测、目标嵌入、预测器输出。在受控可形变物理测试台中构造精确的模拟器状态分叉（改变指令），逐层比较：(1)统计一步栅格观测对中完全相同的比例；(2)在高可见性反事实样本上测量预测器到目标的响应，并做方差归一化；(3)用与目标反事实嵌入位移匹配的各向同性状态扰动做对照，检验预测器对动作路径的利用；(4)比较MSE-only训练与VICReg目标编码器的潜空间误差与谱集中度；(5)用全分辨率栅格与机械状态解码刚度，并结合特权材料参数解码作对照。

Result: 改变的指令确实改变了粒子运动，但41.5%的一步栅格观测对完全相同，说明观测层面大量动作效应不可见。在579个高可见性反事实中，预测器到目标响应中位数在两个种子下仅为0.0051和0.0217，方差归一化后降至0.0027和0.0116。匹配目标反事实嵌入位移的各向同性状态扰动在同一可见对上引起的预测器变化大190倍和53倍，说明预测器未充分利用动作路径，而非预测器死亡或全局收缩。MSE-only训练在匹配种子下10步潜空间误差低8.36倍，但发生在谱高度集中的空间中；一个VICReg目标编码器同样强烈集中，因此误差或秩单独都无法证明物理状态。刚度即便从全分辨率栅格和机械状态解码仍接近随机水平，而特权材料参数可完美解码，表明在该激励下可辨识性弱，而非编码器丢弃了信息。

Conclusion: 低潜空间预测误差不构成世界模型区分动作后果的证据。评估应分别审计四个相互独立的维度：物理效应、观测可见性、表征几何、动作依赖性。只有这样，才能避免把不可见的动作效应、退化的潜空间几何或不可辨识的物理量误判为模型学到了物理动力学。

Abstract: Low latent prediction error does not establish that a world model distinguishes the consequences of its actions. We introduce an evaluation protocol that traces the same intervention through simulator state, raster observations, target embeddings, and predictor outputs. Exact simulator-state forks in a controlled deformable-physics testbed reveal distinct bottlenecks. Changed commands alter particle motion, yet 41.5% of one-step raster pairs are identical. Observation loss is not the whole explanation: among 579 high-visibility counterfactuals, median predictor-to-target response is 0.0051 and 0.0217 across two seeds, falling to 0.0027 and 0.0116 after variance normalization. An isotropic state perturbation matched to the target counterfactual embedding shift produces 190x and 53x larger predictor changes on the same visible pairs, isolating action-path under-use rather than a dead or globally shrunk predictor. MSE-only training gives 8.36x lower 10-step latent error in matched seeds, but in spectrally concentrated spaces; one VICReg target encoder is also strongly concentrated, so neither error nor rank alone certifies physical state. Finally, stiffness remains near chance even from full-resolution rasters and mechanical state while privileged material parameters decode perfectly, indicating weak identifiability under this excitation rather than encoder discard. These results motivate auditing physical effect, observation visibility, representation geometry, and action dependence separately.

</details>


### [275] [NeuroLens: Learning Latent Embeddings of Neural Semantics from Chronic Recordings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02864)
*Hanrui Lyu,Baiyuan Chen,Tianshu Tan,Matthew R. Whiteway,Maxwell D. Melin,Ji Xia,Linyang He,Bradly C. Stadie,Anne Churchland,Liam Paninski,Yizi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NeuroLens 是一个基于 JEPA 的自监督模型，从慢性神经记录中学习去噪的语义隐表征，实现对表征可塑性与记录不稳定性的区分，并提升跨天解码稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经科学长期关注神经活动如何表征高阶认知及其随时间演化，但现有分析工具难以在慢性神经记录中区分"表征可塑性"与"记录不稳定性"这两类混杂因素，限制了长期纵向研究。

Method: 提出 NeuroLens（Latent Embeddings of Neural Semantics），基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的自监督模型。核心包含两部分：自适应编码器将变化的神经群体映射到共享隐空间；时间预测器学习可预测未来隐状态的结构。通过在隐空间（而非原始信号空间）进行预测，捕捉时间上可预测的结构，降低对瞬时、记录特异变异的敏感性。

Result: 在小鼠和人类的慢性皮层内记录上，所学表征提升了对决策和语义任务变量的解码性能。多天预训练使模型能泛化到未来会话、仅用少量样本即可快速适配未见过的神经群体，并且相比当前最优基线在长时间跨度上解码更稳定。

Conclusion: NeuroLens 为研究学习过程及长时间尺度上神经表征如何变化建立了新范式。

Abstract: Understanding how neural activity represents higher-order cognition and how these representations evolve over time has long been a central pursuit in neuroscience. However, current analytical tools cannot easily distinguish representational plasticity from recording instability in chronic neural recordings. Here, we introduce NeuroLens (Latent Embeddings of Neural Semantics), a self-supervised model based on the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) framework that learns denoised, semantically informative latents from chronic neural recordings. An adaptive encoder maps changing neural populations into a common latent space, while a temporal predictor learns structure that supports prediction of future latent states. By predicting in latent space, NeuroLens captures temporally predictable structure and reduces sensitivity to transient, recording-specific variability. Across chronic intracortical data in mice and humans, the learned representations improve decoding of decision-making and semantic task variables. Multi-day pretraining enables generalization to future sessions, rapid few-shot adaptation to unseen neural populations, and more stable decoding over time than state-of-the-art baselines. Together, these results establish NeuroLens as a new paradigm for studying how neural representations change during learning and over long timescales.

</details>


### [276] [On Unlearning for Time-series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02865)
*Zeyu Shi,Yanhui Luo,Ziming Hong,Chongyang Gao,Kezhen Chen,Shanshan Ye,Lixu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RDTU（残差扩散时间序列遗忘框架）：先用保留集NTK预测器生成删除兼容的基预测，再用保留参考数据的体积贡献量化受影响窗口的全局/局部结构支撑，并以扩散模型生成残差修正估计反事实预测形成伪标签场，引导轻量级模型更新，使遗忘后模型最接近精确重训。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列预测常涉及敏感领域，模型训练于纵向用户/实体级记录，可能因隐私、专有信息或传感器故障需删除数据。为避免昂贵的重训，机器遗忘成为隐私保护与数据治理的实用机制。但现有方法难以直接适用于时间序列预测，存在三大挑战：(1) 基于梯度的遗忘不稳定——被删观测参与多个因果关联的预测窗口，参数更新会超出请求区间并损害保留预测效用；(2) 基于标签引导的更新更可控，但连续且依赖上下文的预测缺乏合适替代目标，且遗忘过程中精确重训输出不可得；(3) 被删时间模式在剩余数据中的支撑高度不均——部分受影响窗口仍存在结构相似的对应样本，另一些则代表性不足或被孤立。

Method: RDTU框架包含三步：(1) 使用保留集神经正切核（NTK）预测器获得与删除操作兼容的基预测；(2) 通过保留参考数据的体积贡献（volume contribution）量化每个受影响窗口的全局与局部结构支撑；(3) 利用扩散模型生成残差修正，估计反事实预测，形成伪标签场，用于引导轻量级模型更新。

Result: 实验表明，RDTU持续产生与精确重训（exact retraining）最接近的遗忘后模型。

Conclusion: RDTU通过残差扩散与结构支撑量化，在无需重训的情况下有效实现时间序列机器遗忘，兼顾隐私/数据治理需求与保留预测效用，性能优于现有方法并逼近精确重训。

Abstract: Time-series forecasting is widely used in sensitive domains. Models in these settings are often trained on longitudinal user- or entity-level records, which may later require removal because they contain sensitive or proprietary information or have been corrupted by sensor failures. To address such deletion requests without costly retraining, machine unlearning has been widely studied as a practical mechanism for privacy protection and data governance. However, the application of machine unlearning to time series prediction has not yet been well realized; this is mainly due to the following unique challenges: Gradient-based unlearning can be unstable because a deleted observation participates in multiple causally connected forecasting windows, causing parameter updates to propagate beyond the requested interval and degrade retained forecasting utility. Label-guided updating offers a more controlled alternative, but continuous and context-dependent forecasts lack a suitable replacement target, while the exact-retrained output is unavailable during unlearning. Moreover, the remaining support for a deleted temporal pattern is highly non-uniform. Some affected windows retain structurally similar counterparts in the retained data, whereas others become underrepresented or isolated. We present RDTU, a Residual Diffusion framework for time-series unlearning. RDTU first uses a retained-set neural tangent kernel predictor to obtain a deletion-compatible base forecast. Then it quantifies the global and local structural support of each affected window using the volume contribution of the retained-reference data. Then a diffusion model generates a residual correction that estimates the counterfactual forecast, yielding a pseudo-label field that guides a lightweight model update. Experiments show that RDTU consistently produces unlearned models that most closely match exact retraining.

</details>


### [277] [WebFovea: When the Model Is Right but the Click Is Wrong -- Reliable Round Trips for Vision-Based Web Agents on Live Websites](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03036)
*Jiangang Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 WebFovea，一个在 WebRetriever Challenge 2026 中获得第二名（57.0/100）的视觉型 web agent，核心贡献是揭示并修复了模型与浏览器之间 harness 层四个关键环节的失效问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 能力强的多模态 LLM 对 web agent 是必要的但不充分：模型的决策须经由 harness（模型与页面之间的代码）才能到达浏览器。在真实网站上，观测到的许多失败并非源于模型推理，而是发生在四个环节——回复解析为动作、动作在页面生效、结果准确回传、模型获得所需信息。作者因此希望从 harness 角度系统性剖析并解决这些工程性失效。

Method: 作者将 agent 循环抽象为四阶段框架（解析、生效、回传、呈现），并对每个阶段进行加固，同时在循环外围设置 guardrails 以约束 agent 遵守规则与预算。具体修复包括：纠正导致所有点击落在目标坐标 3/4 处的坐标空间不匹配；处理原生下拉框、iframe 内及文本框中的静默失败动作；消除自我生成的 chat-template token 污染。方法上保持同一模型不变，以隔离 harness 变更的效果。

Result: 在全部四次提交均使用同一模型的前提下，官方隐藏集分数从 31.0 提升至 57.0。自生成的 chat-template token 污染了 4.9% 的任务回合；坐标不匹配使每次点击偏移至目标坐标的 3/4；原生下拉框、iframe 与文本框中的动作出现静默失败。分数提升可归因于 harness 的改进，但仍受真实网站运行间方差影响。

Conclusion: 四阶段视角不依赖于具体模型，尽管部分个别修复是模型相关的。作者给出了各组件的设计、证据（含负面结果）、失效分析、局限性与路线图，其中路线图包括将不同步骤路由到不同模型。

Abstract: We present WebFovea, a vision-based web agent that placed 2nd in the WebRetriever Challenge 2026 with a final score of 57.0 out of 100. The challenge evaluates agents end to end on Protocol III of the WebRetriever benchmark (arXiv:2607.06118): starting from an entry URL on a live website, the agent must operate the site's own interface and return a verifiable answer. A capable multimodal large language model (LLM) is necessary for this, but not sufficient. The model's decisions reach the browser through the harness, the code between the model and the page. At every step, four things must go right: the model's reply must be parsed into the intended action, the action must take effect on the page, the result must be reported back accurately, and the model must be shown the information it needs. On real websites, many of the failures we observed occurred at one of these four stages rather than in the model's reasoning. A coordinate-space mismatch placed every click at 3/4 of its intended coordinates; actions on native dropdowns, inside iframes, and in text boxes failed silently; and self-generated chat-template tokens contaminated 4.9% of task episodes. WebFovea hardens each stage and surrounds the loop with guardrails that keep the agent within the rules and its budget. The four-stage view does not depend on the model, although some individual fixes do. Because we used the same model in all four submissions, the rise of our official hidden-set score from 31.0 to 57.0 reflects changes to the harness, up to run-to-run variance on live sites. We describe the design, the evidence for each component (including negative results), a failure analysis, the limitations, and a roadmap that includes routing different steps to different models.

</details>


### [278] [DIVINE: Simple Cross-Market Stock Pretraining via Diverse Indicator Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02866)
*Kuan-Yu Chen,Shu-Cheng Zheng,Yu-Chen Den,Wei-Cheng Liao,Tien-Hao Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DIVINE跨市场预训练框架，通过从原始OHLCV历史重构技术指标来学习可迁移的金融表征，以轻量编码器在下游股票排序任务上取得领先表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有金融时序预训练目标（掩码观测、对比关系、未来结果）难以同时规避未来监督的不确定性与保持收益预测对齐性，因此需要一种监督定义一致、且与收益预测相关的预训练目标。

Method: DIVINE从观测到的价量历史中计算技术指标并作为重构目标：基于16个标准指标构建77个目标，在六个股票市场数据集上联合预训练，仅将所学编码器迁移至下游股票排序。

Result: 在全部六个市场上，配备0.05M参数的轻量编码器取得最强平均组合表现，优于预训练基线，并与规模大得多的金融基础模型持平或超越，同时保持稳健性与数据高效性。

Conclusion: 指标多样性与市场多样性在迁移中提供互补增益；监督设计与跨市场多样性而非模型规模，才是强可迁移金融表征的关键驱动因素。

Abstract: Financial time-series pretraining typically learns from masked observations, contrastive relations, or future outcomes---yet existing objectives struggle to simultaneously avoid future-supervision uncertainty and maintain return-prediction alignment. We propose DIVINE (DIVerse INdicator rEconstruction), a simple cross-market pretraining framework that reconstructs technical indicators from raw OHLCV history. Computed from observed price-volume history, technical indicators provide consistently defined supervision across markets while summarizing diverse market dynamics with established relevance to return prediction. Pretrained jointly on six-equity market datasets, DIVINE reconstructs 77 targets derived from 16 standard indicators and transfers only the learned encoder to downstream stock ranking. Across all six markets, DIVINE achieves the strongest average portfolio performance with a lightweight 0.05M-parameter encoder, outperforming pretraining baselines and matching or exceeding substantially larger financial foundation models, while remaining robust and data-efficient. Systematic analyses show that indicator diversity and market diversity provide complementary gains in transfer. Together, these results suggest that supervision design and cross-market diversity---rather than model scale---are the key drivers of strong, transferable financial representations.

</details>


### [279] [Distributionally Robust Survival Models under Subpopulation Shift and Outlier Contamination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02868)
*Seonghwi Kim,Sung Ho Jo,Minwoo Chae*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种分布鲁棒生存分析框架，联合应对潜在亚群偏移与离群点污染，通过外层的名义分布精炼与内层最差亚群最大化构造min-max目标，并保留Cox负偏对数似然的risk-set结构，配合交替梯度算法求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异质人群下生存模型平均表现好但某些亚群可能很差；当训练数据同时受离群点污染时该问题更严重。现有方法难以同时处理潜在亚群偏移与污染，且生存损失（如Cox负偏对数似然）不可分解并含样本间交互（risk-set结构），给鲁棒建模带来困难。

Method: 提出分布鲁棒min-max框架：外层最小化通过降低污染样本影响来选择精炼的名义分布，内层最大化聚焦最具挑战性的亚群，从而同时处理潜在亚群偏移与离群污染。该形式直接适配不可分解的生存损失，并保留risk-set结构。采用基于梯度的交替算法求解，外层更新由内层最大化的KKT条件导出。

Result: 在模拟数据和两个生存分析基准上，当亚群偏移与离群污染同时出现时方法仍保持鲁棒；在污染场景下稳定训练，显著提升最差组性能，适用于线性与非线性生存模型，同时总体性能具竞争力甚至有时更优。

Conclusion: 该工作在分布鲁棒优化与生存分析的交叉点提供了统一处理亚群偏移和离群污染的方案，兼顾不可分解损失与样本依赖结构，实验表明其在鲁棒性与整体性能上的有效性。

Abstract: Learning robust survival models under distribution shift is an important but challenging problem in many applications. In heterogeneous populations, a model that performs well on average may still perform poorly on certain subpopulations, and this issue becomes even more severe when the training data are contaminated by outliers. In this paper, we propose a novel distributionally robust framework for survival analysis that jointly addresses latent subpopulation shift and outlier contamination. The proposed method combines an outer minimization that selects a refined nominal distribution by reducing the influence of contaminated samples and an inner maximization that focuses on the most challenging subpopulation. This formulation directly accommodates non-decomposable survival losses while preserving interactions across samples, including the risk-set structure of the Cox negative partial log-likelihood. We develop an alternating gradient-based algorithm with outer updates derived from the KKT conditions of the inner maximization. Experiments on simulated data and two survival benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method remains robust when subpopulation shift and outlier contamination occur simultaneously. It stabilizes training in contaminated settings and substantially improves worst-group performance across both linear and nonlinear survival models, while maintaining competitive and sometimes superior overall performance.

</details>


### [280] [What Should World Models Forget? Stratified Retention for Continual Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03713)
*Nishit Anand,Ramani Duraiswami,Dinesh Manocha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文指出持续学习将旧数据性能下降视为失败的惯例不适用于世界模型，因为世界模型的预测目标（环境）本身是非平稳的。作者提出应按不变性时间尺度分层保留知识，并提出“差异化保留”指标以区分正确修正与灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习沿袭了平稳预测目标的设定，默认正确标签永久正确，因而把对旧数据的退化视为失败。但世界模型的预测目标是不断变化的环境，早期准确的知识可能后来变为错误，主动丢弃它是必要行为而非缺陷。现有概念漂移与语言模型时间事实性研究未针对世界模型进行形式化，而世界模型的独特之处在于它同时编码了永远不应被修正的知识。

Method: 作者从理论上论证世界模型需要按不变性时间尺度进行分层保留：将物理规律、客体永久性等永不修正的不变量，与应随环境变化立即修正的实例级事实区分开。同时提出“差异化保留”（differential retention）评估方案，在适应流上联合报告不变量回归测试与修正延迟，且不做聚合。

Result: 标准遗忘指标无法区分“已正确修正过时知识的世界模型”与“发生灾难性遗忘的世界模型”，因此会把冻结模型排在最高位；而现有物理推理基准也只评估冻结的检查点，存在评估盲区。

Conclusion: 持续世界模型不应以单一遗忘指标衡量，而应采用分层的不变性时间尺度视角，并通过区分不变量回归与修正延迟的差异化保留指标进行评估，以避免将必要的知识更新误判为遗忘。

Abstract: Continual learning treats degradation on previously seen data as evidence of failure, a convention inherited from settings with a stationary prediction target, where a correct label remains correct indefinitely. World models do not satisfy this condition. Their prediction target is the environment, which changes, so knowledge that was accurate when acquired may later become false, and discarding it is required behavior rather than a defect. Non-stationary ground truth is well studied in the concept drift literature and in the temporal factuality of language models, but has not been formulated for world models, which are distinctive in that they also encode knowledge that must never be revised. We argue that continual world models require retention stratified by invariance timescale, separating invariants such as physics and object permanence, which must never be revised, from instance-level facts that should be revised as soon as the environment changes. Standard forgetting metrics cannot distinguish a world model that has correctly revised outdated knowledge from one that has suffered catastrophic forgetting, and consequently rank a frozen model highest, while existing physical-reasoning benchmarks evaluate only frozen checkpoints. We propose differential retention, which reports invariant regression testing across the adaptation stream jointly with revision latency, without aggregation.

</details>


### [281] [Peer Effects in Signed Networks: Separating Influence Through Positive and Negative Ties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02872)
*Xiaojing Du,Jiuyong Li,Lin Liu,Debo Cheng,Jixue Liu,Thuc Duy Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出符号暴露双重稳健估计量(SiDE)，区分正向与负向社会关系以刻画网络干预的因果效应，并给出可识别性条件与近似区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估网络干预需考察处理如何经由社会关系影响个体，但仅统计“被处理的邻居数”而不区分支持性与对抗性关系，会掩盖方向相反的两种影响，导致效应估计出现混杂。

Method: 以正向和负向关系定义效应，包括两类关系的交互效应以及固定总量下在两类关系间重新分配处理的符号构成效应，并给出相应的识别公式；在符号盲分配下说明忽略符号如何混合两类关系的效应。提出SiDE，将符号特定的结果模型与个体处理分配诱导的暴露概率相结合；证明其得分函数的双重稳健性，并评估可处理邻域重叠的近似置信区间。

Result: 在六个真实符号网络上的半合成实验显示效应估计准确，并检验了区间覆盖率的局限。对已发表学校实验数据的探索性再分析得到：经由“共处时间”关系对佩戴腕带的同伴效应为正，但在多重比较校正后，四个效应的区间均包含零。

Conclusion: 该框架通过揭示两类关系的影响何时相互增强或抵消，可为网络干预设计提供依据。

Abstract: Evaluating network interventions requires understanding how treatment affects people through their social relationships. Counting treated neighbors without distinguishing supportive and antagonistic ties can conceal opposing influences. We define effects through positive and negative ties, their interaction, and a sign-composition effect of reallocating treatment between the two types at a fixed total, and give their identification formulas. Under sign-blind assignment, we show how ignoring signs mixes the effects of the two tie types. We propose SiDE (Signed-exposure Doubly robust Estimator), which combines sign-specific outcome models with exposure probabilities induced by individual treatment assignment. We establish double robustness of its score and assess approximate intervals that account for overlapping neighborhoods. Semi-synthetic experiments on six real signed networks demonstrate accurate effect estimation and examine the limits of interval coverage. An exploratory reanalysis of published school-experiment data yields a positive estimate of the peer effect through spend-time ties on wristband wearing, but the intervals for all four effects include zero after adjustment for multiple comparisons. This framework can inform network intervention design by showing when influences through the two tie types reinforce or offset one another.

</details>


### [282] [Toward Omni Multimodal Graph Foundation Model: A Topology-Driven Binding Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02881)
*Xunkai Li,Chenxi Wan,Yinlin Zhu,Wang Luo,Hongchao Qin,Rong-Hua Li,Guoren Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GraphBind，一种以图拓扑为驱动、将多模态信息绑定到统一共享空间的多模态图基础模型方法，在判别与生成任务上均取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中的多模态属性图（MAGs）常存在节点属性不完整的问题，限制了预训练语料的规模与多样性；同时现有MGFMs仅将图拓扑作为结构上下文，忽视了其在引导多模态绑定、塑造统一表示空间中的作用。

Method: GraphBind受图拓扑稳定性启发，利用拓扑为多模态绑定提供结构参考与互补语义信息。具体地，它用拓扑将自身语义与可靠的邻域语义组织进一个融合结构与语义的全局共享空间，并通过轻量级接口将该空间适配到判别与生成任务。

Result: 在11个代表性基线对比下，GraphBind在判别与生成任务上均取得领先表现，相较最强基线的相对提升最高达28.1%。

Conclusion: 以拓扑为驱动的统一共享空间构建能有效缓解属性不完整问题，并统一支撑多模态图上的判别与生成任务，验证了GraphBind的有效性与通用性。

Abstract: Multimodal graph foundation models (MGFMs) seek to learn generalizable representations from large-scale graphs with heterogeneous node modalities. However, real-world Multimodal-Attributed Graphs (MAGs) often contain incomplete node attributes, limiting the scale and diversity of available pretraining corpora. Besides, existing MGFMs primarily incorporate graph topology as structural context, overlooking its role in guiding multimodal binding and shaping a unified representation space. To address these challenges, we propose GraphBind, a topology-driven approach that uses graph topology to bind rich modality information into a unified shared space. GraphBind is motivated by the stability of graph topology, which provides structural references and complementary semantic information for multimodal binding. Concretely, GraphBind uses topology to organize self semantics and reliable neighborhood semantics into a global shared space that integrates structure and semantics, and adapts this space to discriminative and generative tasks through lightweight interfaces. Extensive experiments against 11 representative baselines demonstrate that GraphBind achieves leading performance on both discriminative and generative tasks, with relative improvements of up to 28.1% over the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [283] [DyRA: Dynamic Residual Approximation for Efficient Matrix Multiplication in DNNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02882)
*Daewon Chae,Hyunwon Chung,Changwoo Lee,Hun-Seok Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DyRA提出一种输入自适应方法，通过在推理时动态近似并校正结构化权重近似带来的输出残差误差，以提升矩阵乘法的近似保真度，在视觉、语音和语言模型上均改善精度-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模基础模型推理成本高昂，主要源于稠密矩阵乘法。现有方法以低秩等结构化形式替代稠密权重矩阵以降低开销，但它们近似的是权重而非决定推理精度的输出激活，导致权重空间的小误差会被输入激活放大，产生较大的输出误差。

Method: 提出DyRA，一种输入自适应方法。核心洞见是直接优化输出的低秩因子能更有效地近似矩阵乘法。DyRA据此在推理过程中动态近似并校正由结构化权重近似引入的输出误差，将高效结构化计算与输入相关的校正相结合，在相同计算预算下更忠实地逼近完整矩阵乘法。

Result: 在视觉、语音和语言模型上，DyRA相比仅用结构化权重近似的方法一致地改善了精度-效率权衡。在DINOv3上实现1.5倍端到端GPU加速，同时将精度退化相比仅权重基线降低3倍以上。

Conclusion: 通过将近似目标从权重空间转向输出空间并引入输入自适应校正，DyRA在同等计算预算下实现了更忠实的矩阵乘法近似，验证了直接优化输出低秩因子的有效性。

Abstract: Large-scale foundation models achieve strong performance across diverse tasks, but their size makes inference costly, largely due to dense matrix multiplications. Prior work reduces this cost by replacing dense weight matrices with efficient structured forms such as low-rank factorizations. However, these methods approximate weights rather than the output activations that determine inference accuracy. Consequently, small weight-space errors can be amplified by input activations, producing large output errors. In this work, we propose DyRA, an input-adaptive method that improves structured matrix multiplication approximation by correcting residual output errors during inference. We show that matrix multiplication can be approximated more effectively by directly optimizing low-rank factors of the output. DyRA builds on this insight by dynamically approximating and correcting the output error introduced by structured weight approximations. This combines efficient structured computation with input-dependent correction, yielding a more faithful approximation of full matrix multiplication under the same computational budget. Across vision, speech, and language models, DyRA consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off over structured weight approximations alone. Notably, DyRA achieves a 1.5$\times$ end-to-end GPU speedup for DINOv3 while reducing accuracy degradation by more than 3$\times$ relative to weight-only baselines.

</details>


### [284] [When Can We Trust the Matching Principle? Robust Deployment Geometry Under Finite-Sample and Model Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02894)
*Vishal Rajput*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文量化了匹配决策中"匹配已知几何 vs. 扩散惩罚"的选择，提出信任比 τ=ε/γ，证明在线性二次匹配响应下估计匹配与oracle匹配的相对漂移在Davis-Kahan分离区（τ<1/2）内按O(τ²)缩放，并提出置信校准匹配（CCM）策略，实验验证了两种机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有匹配方法在几何不可识别时仍强行匹配，导致估计匹配与oracle匹配之间产生漂移。作者希望量化"何时应匹配、何时应扩散惩罚"这一决策，并给出其误差随不确定性增长的规律。

Method: 引入信任比 τ=ε/γ（估计不确定性ε与谱分离度γ之比）；在linear-quadratic Matching响应下，分析所选top-r部署子空间内估计投影与oracle投影匹配的相对漂移；提出Confidence-Calibrated Matching（CCM），根据τ将策略在方向性（τ小）与逐步各向同性（τ大）之间切换，阈值由校准而非定理决定。

Result: 在Davis-Kahan分离区τ<1/2内，oracle-relative漂移按O(τ²)缩放（实际可用性取决于常数）；实验展示了两种机制，在UCI HAR嵌入上，always-match在每个单元格都劣于abstain。

Conclusion: τ=ε/γ可作为匹配vs.扩散惩罚的量化判据；CCM将τ转化为可校准策略；理论保证仅在分离区τ<1/2成立，soft策略多为启发式，且实验显示盲目匹配在嵌入空间中可能反而不如弃权。

Abstract: Match only geometry you can identify; otherwise spread the penalty. We quantify that decision by the trust ratio tau = epsilon / gamma (estimation uncertainty over spectral separation). Under the linear-quadratic Matching response, oracle-relative drift between estimated and oracle projector matching scales as tau^2 for probes in the chosen top-r deployment subspace -- O(tau^2) in the Davis-Kahan separation region tau < 1/2, with practical usefulness depending on constants. Confidence-Calibrated Matching (CCM) turns tau into a policy -- directional when tau is small, progressively isotropic when not -- with thresholds from calibration, not from the theorem (match sits in the separation region; soft is mostly heuristic). Experiments show both regimes, including UCI HAR embeddings where always-match is worse than abstain on every cell.

</details>


### [285] [Tangent Schrödinger Bridge Matching: Learning Stochastic Transport with Mechanistic Sensitivities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02906)
*Jowaria Khan,Elizabeth Bondi-Kelly*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出Tangent Schrödinger Bridge Matching (Tangent-SBM)，通过从端点观测和机制敏感性中学习随机传输，使模型不仅能匹配结果分布，还能准确预测系统对参数变化的响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机系统对黏度、反应速率或外力变化的响应预测通常依赖昂贵的模拟，因此需要可复用的学习模型。然而仅匹配观测到的结果分布并不能保证准确的干预响应，这是现有方法的关键不足。

Method: Tangent-SBM从端点观测和机制敏感性中学习随机传输，在传播轨迹的同时传播参数导数，并用给定目标进行监督。针对平均响应目标，单次 rollout 的平方误差会额外惩罚响应变异性；为此该目标使用两次独立 rollout 来匹配均值，从而避免这一附加惩罚。此外建立了敏感性精度限定有限变化预测误差与决策后悔的条件。

Result: 在高斯、随机双井、PDEBench反应-扩散以及随机Navier-Stokes系统上，Tangent-SBM在保持可比的端点与分布精度的同时，相对匹配的conditional-bridge基线提升了敏感性和有限变化预测。消融实验考察了目标正确性、响应目标和模拟器预算分配。在Navier-Stokes的校准黏度选择中，Tangent-SBM相较不采取行动降低了跟踪误差。

Conclusion: Tangent-SBM通过结合端点观测与机制敏感性监督，实现了对随机系统干预响应的准确预测，并在多种系统与决策任务中验证了其有效性和决策实用性。

Abstract: Predicting how stochastic systems respond to changes in viscosity, reaction rates, or external forces requires costly simulations, motivating reusable learned models. Yet matching observed outcome distributions does not ensure accurate intervention responses. We introduce Tangent Schrödinger Bridge Matching (Tangent-SBM), which learns stochastic transports from endpoint observations and mechanistic sensitivities. It propagates parameter derivatives alongside trajectories and supervises them against supplied targets. For average-response targets, single-rollout squared error also penalizes response variability; our objective uses two independent rollouts to match the mean without this additional penalty. We establish conditions under which sensitivity accuracy bounds finite-change prediction error and decision regret. Across Gaussian, stochastic double-well, PDEBench reaction--diffusion, and stochastic Navier--Stokes systems, Tangent-SBM improves sensitivity and finite-change prediction over matched conditional-bridge baselines while maintaining comparable endpoint and distributional accuracy. Controls examine target correctness, response objectives, and simulator-budget allocation. To test decision usefulness, we evaluate calibrated viscosity selection in Navier--Stokes: Tangent-SBM reduces tracking error relative to taking no action on every evaluated task.

</details>


### [286] [Do ResNets Route? Sparse Interaction Experts in Residual Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02907)
*Liang Yan,Siying Chen,Kaijie Chen,Bo Li,Jinghao Zhang,Mu Miao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将训练好的ResNet建模为二元残差分支掩码上的集合函数，用Möbius反演把网络输出精确分解为各阶残差修正与高阶交互，并在ImageNet预训练的ResNet-18/34上做穷举分析，发现交互质量峰值出现在高阶（5阶、10阶）而非低阶。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ResNet对每个输入都执行所有残差块，但各块的功能贡献未必与输入无关。作者希望量化残差分支之间的相互作用（interaction），检验"密集执行是否等价于功能上的均匀贡献"，并探究是否存在隐式的输入相关路由。

Method: 将ResNet表示为对二进制残差掩码的集合函数；利用Möbius反演将其输出精确分解为各阶（k-way）残差修正与高阶交互项；在残差缩放假设下分析平滑残差堆叠中固定k阶交互项的尺度，理论上应为O(λ^k)；对ImageNet预训练的ResNet-18/34进行穷举式交互谱分析。

Result: ResNet-18与ResNet-34的交互质量峰值分别出现在第5阶和第10阶，而非低阶；减小残差缩放使两个谱向低阶移动，但会改变模型预测。交互系数在幅度上集中但并非硬稀疏，且保持预测的稀疏性随深度增加而减弱。主导交互随输入和预测类别变化，围绕一个共享的全局核心变动；整体复杂度随样本难度变化不大。

Conclusion: 密集ResNet实现了一种隐式的软路由：每个块都被执行，但不同输入依赖不同的"残差交互专家"。路由可以在功能贡献层面自发涌现，而无需显式路由器或稀疏执行。

Abstract: Residual networks execute every block for every input, yet their functional contributions need not be input independent. We formulate a trained ResNet as a set function over binary residual-branch masks and apply Möbius inversion to decompose its output exactly into individual residual corrections and higher-order interactions. For smooth residual stacks, we show that each fixed $k$-way interaction scales as $\mathcal{O}(λ^k)$ under residual scaling. Exhaustive analysis of ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-18 and ResNet-34 reveals that interaction mass peaks at orders five and ten, respectively, rather than at low orders. Reducing the residual scale shifts both spectra toward lower orders, but also changes model predictions. The interaction coefficients are concentrated in magnitude but not hard sparse, and prediction-preserving sparsity weakens with depth. Crucially, the dominant interactions vary across inputs and predicted classes around a shared global core, while their overall complexity changes little with sample difficulty. These results show that dense ResNets implement an implicit form of soft routing: every block is executed, but different inputs rely on different residual interaction experts. Routing can therefore emerge at the level of functional contribution without an explicit router or sparse execution.

</details>


### [287] [Constraint-Aware Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02909)
*Jinwoo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出约束解码与标准训练存在重复学习，提出"约束感知"训练目标将分析外置，并用三个定理及合成实验证明其可提升模型与数据效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型生成程序时，约束解码会利用程序分析（语法、作用域、类型规则）排除违规token，但标准训练其实已教会模型抑制这些token，二者存在重复。作者因此追问：既然推理时反正要做分析过滤token，能否在训练中完全不教这一分析？这种"外置"是否带来更高效的模型？

Method: 定义了一个满足外置期望的通用约束感知目标（constraint-aware objective），并将外置带来的收益形式化为三个关于模型规模与数据效率的定理；随后通过受控合成实验验证理论在训练动态下是否成立。

Result: 在参数量和训练数据匹配的条件下，约束感知训练相比普通交叉熵训练取得更低的预测损失，说明其压缩了模型规模并提升了数据效率，三个定理在训练动态下仍然成立。

Conclusion: 将推理时使用的程序分析外置到解码阶段、而非在训练中教会模型，可减少冗余学习并提升效率；这为设计纳入生成期分析的训练目标提供了理论与实验依据。

Abstract: When generating programs with language models, constrained decoding can apply program analyses to exclude tokens that violate syntax, scope, or typing rules. However, there is a duplication: standard training already teaches the model to suppress the tokens rejected by these analyses. This duplication leads to the question: if we will perform some analysis to filter a set tokens out during inference anyways, can we avoid teaching the model the said analysis altogether during training, and does this externalization lead to more efficient models? This paper defines a general constraint-aware objective satisfying this externalization desideratum and formalizes the benefits of externalization into three concrete theorems about model size and data efficiency. We show, through a controlled synthetic experiment, that the theorems survive training dynamics: constraint-aware training yields lower prediction loss at a matched parameter count and data compared to ordinary cross-entropy training, motivating training objectives that incorporate the analyses used during generation.

</details>


### [288] [Dynamic Expert Pruning for Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02951)
*Jabin Koo,Soheil Abbasloo,Sungjae Lee,Jungseul Ok*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出动态专家剪枝（DEP），利用智能体的系统提示与任务提示直接预测每个请求所需的专家子集，生成请求级掩码，从而突破MoE模型静态剪枝的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE架构虽通过稀疏激活降低计算量，但所有专家仍需常驻加速器，内存成为部署瓶颈。现有专家剪枝采用离线校准的单一静态掩码，在异构负载（尤其多智能体系统中）失效：不同任务与角色会调用不同专家，而静态方法对所有任务使用固定子集。

Method: DEP（Dynamic Expert Pruning）基于一个发现：智能体的系统提示与任务提示本身已足以标识该智能体及其任务所需的专家。方法训练一个轻量级预测器（仅需一次基于工作流文本的训练），在单次前向传播中将提示映射为针对每个请求的专用剪枝掩码，无需逐配置校准。

Result: 在多种任务与角色、不同模型规模和MoE架构上，DEP的整体准确率优于静态剪枝与专家合并基线，并能泛化到训练中未见过的工作流而无需重训练。在保留专家数较少时，DEP相对基线的优势最大。

Conclusion: 多智能体系统内在的角色特化特性使得比静态剪枝更稀疏的服务成为可能，DEP验证了以提示为条件进行请求级动态专家剪枝的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale language models efficiently by activating only a few experts per token, but the saving is confined to computation: every expert must stay resident on the accelerator, so memory bounds where these models can be deployed. Expert pruning reduces this footprint, yet existing methods are static --- a single mask, calibrated offline, is applied to the model for every subsequent request. This assumption can fail when the workload is heterogeneous, most prominently in multi-agent systems, where one backbone serves many tasks and roles at once: our analysis shows that different tasks and roles recruit different experts, while static methods assign one fixed subset to all of them. We therefore propose Dynamic Expert Pruning (DEP), which rests on a finding we establish here: an agent's system and task prompts are by themselves sufficient to identify the experts that agent and its task require, since that text already describes what the agent will do. A lightweight predictor, trained once on workflow transcripts, turns those prompts into a specialized per-request mask in a single forward pass, with no per-configuration calibration. Across diverse tasks and roles, model scales, and MoE architectures, DEP achieves better overall accuracy than static pruning and merging baselines, and generalizes to workflows unseen in training without retraining. Its margin over those baselines is largest when few experts are retained, suggesting that the role specialization inherent to multi-agent systems permits sparser serving than static pruning allows.

</details>


### [289] [SlimKV: Joint Token-Feature KV Cache Compression with Reconstruction-Free Beacon Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02953)
*Zihan Teng,Jiayu Zhao,Wentao Ren,Minhao Fan,Tianrui Ma,Song Chen,Weichen Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SlimKV：一种与问题无关的 token-特征联合 KV-cache 压缩方法，通过低秩感知训练、层级自适应秩分配与 K-RoPE-free 约束实现潜空间注意力，在保持精度的同时显著提升长上下文解码效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 服务受限于 KV-cache 显存，尤其在资源受限场景。现有压缩策略存在两难：token 级方法减少缓存状态但通过驱逐或压缩带来信息损失风险；特征级方法降低每 token 的 KV 维度，但应用位置嵌入时往往需要全维重建，限制了解码加速。

Method: SlimKV 采用低秩感知训练将长上下文压缩为带潜 KV 表示的 beacon memory states，并进行层级自适应秩分配。同时发现位置不对称性：移除 key 端 RoPE 对 beacon token 与原始 token 影响不同，beacon token 退化更小。据此在 K-RoPE-free 约束下训练 beacon KV 投影，并在解码时启用潜空间注意力以减少重建延迟。

Result: 在 LongBench 上，SlimKV 在 16x/32x 压缩下优于基线，在 4x/8x 下仍保持领先，并保留未压缩模型 96% 以上得分。Needle-in-a-Haystack 验证其在证据位置上的鲁棒性；效率评估显示 128K 长度下注意力加速最高 7.34x，端到端解码加速最高 3.38x。

Conclusion: SlimKV 通过 token-特征联合压缩与潜空间注意力，在长上下文场景中兼顾压缩率、精度与解码效率，验证了位置不对称性利用的可行性。

Abstract: Long-context LLM serving is increasingly bottlenecked by KV-cache memory, especially in resource-constrained scenarios. Among existing KV-cache compression strategies, token-wise methods reduce cached states but risk information loss through eviction or condensation, while feature-wise methods reduce per-token KV dimensions but can require full-dimensional reconstruction to apply positional embedding, limiting decoding speedups. We introduce SlimKV, a question-agnostic joint token-feature KV-cache compression method. SlimKV uses low-rank-aware training to compress long contexts into beacon memory states with latent KV representations, together with layer-adaptive rank allocation. We further uncover a positional asymmetry: removing key-side RoPE affects beacon and raw tokens differently, with much smaller degradation for beacon tokens. Exploiting this asymmetry, SlimKV trains beacon KV projections under a K-RoPE-free constraint and enables latent-space attention during decoding, mitigating reconstruction latency. On LongBench, SlimKV outperforms baselines at 16x/32x compression and remains leading at 4x/8x, where it retains over 96% of the uncompressed model's score. Needle-in-a-Haystack confirms robustness across evidence positions, and efficiency evaluation shows up to 7.34x attention speedup and 3.38x end-to-end decoding speedup over the uncompressed model at 128K length.

</details>


### [290] [Hyperparameter selection for equation learning with biologically-informed neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02954)
*William Lavery,Jodie A. Cochrane,John T. Nardini,Sara Hamis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一套用于生物信息神经网络（BINNs）超参数选择的诊断工作流，在未知真实方程的情况下，通过三个关键问题指导超参数选取，并在多个合成系统上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BINNs适用于方程高度非线性、仅部分已知且数据稀疏嘈杂的生物系统，但其实际应用严重依赖超参数选择，而超参数常凭经验选取且鲜有记录，限制了结果的可复现性与方法的可迁移性。因此需要一个在真实方程未知时仍可用的结构化超参数选择流程。

Method: 提出一套由三个核心问题引导的诊断工作流：(1) 更大网络容量的收益是否值得其代价？(2) 更多训练轮次是否持续降低验证损失？(3) 随着网络容量和训练增加，学到的项是否停止变化？并将该工作流应用于具有已知真值的不同复杂度合成系统，涵盖扩散项与增长项右端项，数据从1D+t到2D+t。

Result: 验证损失总体能跟随所学项的真实误差变化。作者据此提炼出BINNs架构中超参数选择的实用经验法则，并给出建议的起始取值。

Conclusion: 该工作通过提供结构化工作流、实践指南及超参数起始建议值，降低了基于BINN进行方程学习的门槛，提升了结果的可复现性与方法的可迁移性。

Abstract: Biologically-informed neural networks (BINNs) have emerged as a flexible subclass of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for learning terms in partial differential equations from data. BINNs are particularly suited for biological systems, where the governing equations are highly nonlinear and only partially known a priori, and where data observations are often sparse, noisy, and incomplete. However, applying BINNs effectively in practice depends critically on hyperparameter selection, which remains a central challenge in equation-learning frameworks. Hyperparameters are often chosen heuristically and only cursorily documented, which limits the reproducibility of results and the transferability of methods. We present a diagnostic workflow for hyperparameter selection that can be used when the ground-truth equations are not known. The workflow is guided by three main questions: (1) Are the benefits of greater network capacity worth the cost? (2) Do more training epochs keep reducing the validation loss? (3) Do the learned terms stop changing as network capacity and training increase? We apply our workflow to synthetic systems of varying complexity with known ground truth, spanning diffusion and growth right-hand side terms and data ranging from 1D+t to 2D+t. We demonstrate that the validation loss generally follows the true error in the learned terms and distil practical rules of thumb for selecting hyperparameters in the BINN architecture. By providing a structured workflow, practical guidelines, and suggested starting values for hyperparameter selection, this work lowers the barrier to BINN-based equation learning.

</details>


### [291] [Dirac-Interconnected Neural Elements: Discovering Modularity in Physical Systems Without Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02960)
*Reiho Li,Razmik Arman Khosrovian,Takaharu Yaguchi,Hiroaki Yoshimura,Takashi Matsubara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DINEs模型，将物理系统表示为微分-代数方程，其中代数约束由核表示的Dirac结构给出，可同时从数据中辨识互联结构并学习子系统特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习在动力系统建模上的成功主要源于基于物理先验（如能量守恒、辛结构）的归纳偏置，但现有方法未充分利用真实物理系统是组件互联这一事实：部分方法要求互联已知，另一些则假设系统可约化为ODE并只学习约化后的ODE，从而丢弃了互联带来的代数约束。

Method: 提出Dirac互联神经单元（DINEs），将物理系统建模为微分-代数方程（DAE），其代数约束由核表示（kernel representation）的Dirac结构给出。该方法从数据中同时辨识组件间的互联（作为Dirac结构）并学习组件特性（作为神经网络），使所学子系统保持未约化形式，并可隔离或组合以构建新系统而无需重新训练，同时可处理部分可观测系统。

Result: 实验结果表明DINEs具备上述能力，并在现有方法无法处理的物理系统上取得了成功。

Conclusion: 通过以Dirac结构刻画互联约束、以神经网络学习组件特性，DINEs在保持子系统未约化形式的同时实现了可组合、可分离且支持部分观测的物理系统建模，拓展了数据驱动动力系统建模的能力边界。

Abstract: Deep learning has shown remarkable success in the data-driven modeling of dynamical systems. Much of its success is attributed not to the flexibility of neural networks but to inductive biases based on physical prior knowledge, such as energy conservation and symplecticity. However, existing methods do not fully exploit the fact that real-world physical systems are interconnections of components. Some methods require the interconnection to be known a priori, while others assume the system to be reducible to an ordinary differential equation (ODE) and learn only the reduced ODE, discarding the algebraic constraints imposed by the interconnection. Here, we propose Dirac-interconnected neural elements (DINEs), a neural network model that represents a physical system as a differential-algebraic equation (DAE), whose algebraic constraints are given by a Dirac structure in kernel representation. With DINEs, we simultaneously identify from data the interconnection among the components as a Dirac structure and learn the characteristics of the components as neural networks. This allows us to keep the learned subsystems in unreduced form and isolate or compose them to make a new system without retraining. Moreover, DINEs can handle partially observable systems. Experimental results demonstrate these capabilities on physical systems beyond the reach of existing methods.

</details>


### [292] [Differentiable Koopman Operator for Contrastive Learning on Dynamic Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02990)
*Md Abrar Jahin,Taufikur Rahman Fuad,Md Rizwan Parvez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KAIROS在动态图对比学习框架中嵌入可微Koopman算子，将时序演化在学习到的表示空间中线性化，用于动态图异常检测与节点分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实交互网络本质上是动态的：边随节点行为变化而生成与消失。现有基于快照的对比方法仅在编码器权重中隐式编码时序依赖，缺乏对节点表示如何演化的显式建模，导致其在分布偏移下表现脆弱。

Method: 提出自监督框架KAIROS（Koopman-Aligned Invariant Representations for Open Dynamic Systems）。核心是将可微Koopman算子嵌入动态图对比学习回路，以在嵌入空间中线性化时序演化。采用双视图编码器，将原始节点特征与图扩散结构视图配对，并在多个时间窗口上以多粒度对比目标进行优化。异常检测使用Koopman预测残差，结合时序不一致性与局部邻域偏差，将异常行为与可预测的图演化区分开。

Result: 在九个动态图基准上评估，KAIROS在全部九个数据集上取得最先进的异常检测结果，相较先前工作最高提升23.15个ROC-AUC点，同时在无监督节点分类任务上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 显式的动态建模为时序图表示学习提供了一种可扩展且有效的归纳偏置。

Abstract: Real-world interaction networks are inherently dynamic: edges form and dissolve as node behavior shifts over time. Most snapshot-based contrastive methods encode temporal dependencies implicitly in encoder weights, without an explicit model of how node representations evolve, making them brittle under distribution shifts. We propose KAIROS (Koopman-Aligned Invariant Representations for Open Dynamic Systems), a self-supervised framework that embeds a differentiable Koopman operator within a dynamic graph contrastive learning loop to linearize temporal evolution in the learned embedding space. A dual-view encoder pairs raw node features with a graph-diffused structural view and is optimized with multi-granularity contrastive objectives across temporal windows. For anomaly detection, KAIROS uses the Koopman prediction residual together with temporal inconsistency and local neighborhood deviation to separate irregular behavior from predictable graph evolution. Evaluated on nine dynamic graph benchmarks, KAIROS achieves state-of-the-art anomaly detection results on all nine datasets, with gains of up to 23.15 ROC-AUC points over prior work, while remaining competitive for unsupervised node classification. These results show that explicit dynamics modeling provides a scalable and effective inductive bias for temporal graph representation learning.

</details>


### [293] [Temporal Geometry of Deep Networks: Hyperbolic Representations of Training Dynamics for Intrinsic Explainability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03000)
*Ambarish Moharil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于双曲几何（Poincaré 模型）与时序参数图的元学习框架，用于刻画 MLP 在优化/训练过程中权重拓扑的几何演化，从而获得内在可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内在可解释性仍是难题，尤其在 MLP 需要于优化环境中动态重训练的背景下。传统基于度量的方法仅分析单一检查点，忽略了训练轨迹所携带的信息；作者认为神经网络不仅把信息编码在权重中，也编码在训练过程中形成的轨迹里，因此需要一种能动态刻画其自组织与几何演化的表示方法。

Method: 构建时序参数图：对 MLP 优化/训练过程在 T 个时间步上取快照。借鉴复杂网络可嵌入隐藏度量空间（距离对应连接可能性）的思想，提出几何且时序的图基元学习框架，将时序参数图嵌入 Poincaré 双曲球模型，并学习其动态表示。模型保持对快照内神经元置换的等变性以及对历史快照置换的不变性，从而在时间维度上保持功能等价，并恢复网络潜在演化的几何结构。

Result: 在回归与分类任务上，基于训练好的 MLP 进行实验，元网络表现出强劲性能，并得到双曲时序表示；这些表示揭示了网络结构在特定训练环境下随时间涌现的过程。

Conclusion: 该框架通过双曲时序参数图表示，能够捕捉 MLP 权重拓扑的几何演化与自组织过程，为理解神经网络在训练中的结构涌现提供了新的可解释性视角。

Abstract: Intrinsic explainability remains a challenging problem, particularly in contexts where multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) require dynamic re-training within an optimization environment. This paper investigates how MLPs and their training dynamics can be represented and studied in non-Euclidean spaces; our representation features the Poincaré model of hyperbolic geometry. We aim to capture the geometric evolution of their weighted topology and self-organization over time. Instead of restricting the analysis to single checkpoints---as per established measure-based explainability methods---we construct temporal \textit{parameter graphs}, i.e., snapshots over time $T$ steps of the optimization/training process for MLPs. This reflects the view that neural networks encode information not only in their weights but also in the trajectory traced during training. Drawing on the idea that many complex networks admit embeddings in hidden metric spaces where distances correspond to connection likelihood, we present a geometric and temporal graph-based metalearning framework for obtaining dynamic hyperbolic representations of the underlying neural parameter graphs. Our model embeds temporal parameter graphs in the Poincaré model ball, and learns from them while maintaining equivariance to within-snapshot neuron permutations and invariance to permutations of past snapshots. In doing so, the approach preserves functional equivalence over time and recovers the latent evolving geometry of the network. Experiments on regression and classification tasks with trained MLPs show strong meta-network performance, accompanied by hyperbolic temporal representations. This reveals how the network structure emerges over time under specific training environments, thus providing insights into the network's self-organization.

</details>


### [294] [Neural Data Needs Semantic Tokenization: Behavioral Events as Boundaries of Session-Transferable Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03001)
*Sangyoon Bae,Jiook Cha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TWS（Tokenization with States），以群体活动状态而非单个神经元/会话作为token单位，实现跨会话、跨物种的神经解码与泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细胞外电生理每次记录到不同神经元集合，神经基础模型将每个神经元和会话嵌入token，导致新会话成为未见输入而无法泛化。需要一种所有会话共享、且携带行为信息的token单位。

Method: TWS在刺激起始、运动起始等任务事件处将每个trial切分为多个状态（regime），将每个状态转换为群体几何token，不使用任何神经元或会话嵌入。

Result: 在留出的IBL会话上，TWS即使从无目标信息的regime边界也能解码运动，而逐神经元基础模型仅为随机水平；仅用小鼠数据训练后冻结，TWS仅凭线性探针即可迁移到猕猴和Utah阵列；在reach direction上达到MCC 0.23（仅用事件时间为0.01）。

Conclusion: 跨会话泛化中，token设计比上层模型更重要；群体活动状态是可跨神经元更替、跨物种对齐的稳定token单位。

Abstract: Extracellular electrophysiology records a different set of neurons in every session. Neural foundation models embed each neuron and each session into their tokens, so every new session is an input they have never seen, and they fail to generalize to it. A tokenizer for new sessions needs a unit that every session shares and that carries behavior. Population activity offers such a unit. It evolves on a low-dimensional manifold that persists across neuronal turnover and across animals once sessions are aligned. This manifold changes regime at task events such as stimulus onset and movement onset. Within each regime the population occupies a state, the part of the manifold it spans between two events, and each state carries its own behavioral meaning. We propose Tokenization with States (TWS), which segments each trial, one repetition of the task, at these events and converts every state into tokens of population geometry, with no neuron or session embedding. On held-out International Brain Laboratory (IBL) sessions, TWS decodes movement even from regime boundaries that carry no information about the target, while a per-neuron foundation model pretrained on those sessions decodes at chance. Frozen after training on mice alone, TWS transfers to macaques and Utah arrays with only a linear probe. On reach direction, a target that its boundaries do not define, it achieves a Matthews correlation of 0.23, where the event time alone achieves $0.01$. For cross-session generalization, the token matters more than the model on top.

</details>


### [295] [AvoKV-E: Payload-Aware KV Cache Eviction for Long Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03007)
*Han Yu,Wenhui Zhu,Xiwen Chen,Zhipeng Wang,Hejian Sang,Han Shi,Menglin Zhou,Xuanzhao Dong,Minzhou Huang,Rui Cai,Hao Wang,Alborz Geramifard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出免训练KV缓存淘汰策略AvoKV-E，通过延迟近期状态的淘汰资格并对合格条目按归一化读取压力、键冗余和值载荷潜力排序，在紧缓存场景下超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长输出推理使KV缓存瓶颈从固定提示转移到生成轨迹。现有推理缓存淘汰方法将缓存条目视为“路由对象”，仅估计旧键是否会被再次读取或复用，忽略了两个效应：低注意力条目可能承载大值载荷，其移除会改变未来预测；新生成状态在后续查询读取前就可能显得陈旧。

Method: AvoKV-E为免训练淘汰策略，两步：先延迟近期状态的淘汰资格（延迟观察），再对合格条目使用候选归一化读取压力、键冗余度和值载荷潜力进行综合排序打分。

Result: 在多个模型和数据集上，于相同活跃KV预算下，AvoKV-E匹配或超过冗余感知、递归基和思维自适应淘汰基线，在缓存最紧张时增益最大。消融与反事实分析表明增益来自延迟观察、载荷感知评分、冗余度和尺度稳健归一化。

Conclusion: 长推理KV淘汰不应只保留可能被读取的键，还应保留支撑推理轨迹的值载荷。

Abstract: Long-output reasoning shifts the KV-cache bottleneck from the fixed prompt to the generated trace. Existing reasoning-cache eviction methods largely treat cached entries as routing objects, estimating whether an old key will still be read, will recur, or can be replaced. This routing-only view overlooks two effects: low-attention entries can carry large value payloads whose removal changes future predictions, and newly generated states can appear stale before later queries have had a chance to read them. We introduce AvoKV-E, a training-free eviction policy that first delays eligibility for recent states and then ranks eligible entries using candidate-normalized read pressure, key redundancy, and value-payload potential. According to empirical evaluation across different models and datasets, AvoKV-E matches or exceeds redundancy-aware, recurrence-based, and thought-adaptive eviction baselines at matched active-KV budgets, with its largest gains in the tightest-cache regime. Component and counterfactual analyses further connect these gains to delayed observation, payload-aware scoring, redundancy, and scale-robust normalization. Together, the results show that long-reasoning KV eviction should preserve not only keys that are likely to be read, but also the value payloads that sustain the reasoning trajectory.

</details>


### [296] [Signal Simplification Is Not Predictive Simplification: Diagnosing Residual Neural Forecasting in Short-Horizon Volatility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03019)
*Bingqi Lian,Linfeng Cheng,Mei Lu,Jerry Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过信号-预测-系统诊断框架，检验“成功统计第一阶段必然留下更干净、更可学的残差目标”这一混合统计-神经管道常见假设，发现残差统计简化并未转化为有效的神经预处理收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合统计-神经管道普遍假设：统计第一阶段（如HAR模型）成功后，其残差会更干净、更易被下游神经网络学习。作者试图在短周期波动率预测任务中检验这一假设是否成立。

Method: 采用信号-预测-系统诊断框架，在五个高流动性美股资产上，以波动率对齐的HAR风格模型对比AR、MA、ARIMA；在扩展训练窗口内考察用于构造残差LSTM序列的标准化前拟合残差过程，并独立考察滚动伪样本外HAR误差的方差与滞后1自相关；再对残差-only LSTM增强与纯LSTM进行对比。

Result: 波动率对齐HAR风格模型优于AR、MA、ARIMA。标准化前拟合残差过程方差比对应目标低约82%，滞后1自相关接近零；滚动伪样本外HAR误差方差降低约74%，滞后1依赖同样微弱。但残差-only LSTM增强使MSE从0.3049升至0.3594（平均），且每个资产均恶化；纯LSTM取得最低的伪样本外MSE 0.2649，残差混合模型耗时显著更长却未提升精度。

Conclusion: 作者将该现象命名为“预测器-预处理器不对称”（forecaster-preconditioner asymmetry）：第一阶段的预测成功与统计残差简化，并不必然转化为有益的下游神经预处理效果。

Abstract: Hybrid statistical-neural pipelines often assume that a successful statistical first stage leaves a cleaner and more learnable residual target. We examine that assumption in short-horizon volatility forecasting through a signal-forecast-system diagnostic framework. Across five liquid U.S. assets, a volatility-aligned HAR-style model outperforms AR, MA, and ARIMA. Within expanding training windows, the pre-standardization fitted residual process used to construct residual-LSTM sequences has about 82% lower variance than the corresponding target and near-zero lag-1 autocorrelation; independently, rolling pseudo-out-of-sample HAR errors show about 74% variance reduction and similarly weak lag-1 dependence. Residual-only LSTM augmentation nevertheless raises mean squared error from 0.3049 to 0.3594 on average, with deterioration on every asset. Pure LSTM records the lowest selected pseudo-out-of-sample MSE, 0.2649, while the residual hybrid requires substantially more end-to-end runtime without improving accuracy. We describe this pattern as forecaster-preconditioner asymmetry: first-stage forecasting success and statistical residual simplification need not translate into useful downstream neural preconditioning.

</details>


### [297] [Balancing Multimodal Learning via Functional Progress](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03035)
*Zhongjing Gu,Fengqiang Wan,Yiming Cui,Yufa Feng,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FGMO方法，利用函数空间进度信号估计并协调多模态优化，缓解模态不平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态学习方法多从预测不确定性或优化统计的分数差异估计模态不平衡，但各模态的预测不确定性与学习动态不同，直接比较这些分数会把内在模态差异误判为进度差距，导致不平衡估计有偏。

Method: FGMO包含两个组件：功能进度估计（FPE）度量各模态更新引起的函数空间响应，并以损失对齐的单模态参考进行校准，得到可比的进度信号；功能响应控制（FRC）据此重新分配模态级函数空间预算，并通过张量级学习率调整实现目标响应。

Result: 理论分析建立了FRC在有界控制器状态失配下的一步目标收缩性质；大量实验在多个多模态基准上验证了FGMO的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过函数空间进度信号而非分数差异来评估模态优化进度，可实现更可靠的模态不平衡估计与协调优化。

Abstract: Multimodal learning often suffers from modality imbalance, where the joint optimization process is dominated by a single modality. Existing methods typically estimate modality imbalance from score disparities derived from prediction uncertainty or optimization statistics. However, due to distinct prediction uncertainty and learning dynamics across modalities, direct comparison of such scores may misinterpret intrinsic modality differences as progress gaps, leading to biased imbalance estimation. In this paper, we propose Function-Space Guided Multimodal Optimization (FGMO), which leverages a function-space progress signal to assess modality-wise optimization progress and coordinate optimization across modalities to alleviate modality imbalance. Specifically, we introduce Functional Progress Estimation (FPE) to measure each modality's update-induced function-space response and calibrate it against a loss-aligned unimodal reference, producing a comparable progress signal. Based on this signal, Functional Response Control (FRC) redistributes modality-level function-space budgets and realizes the target responses through tensor-wise learning-rate adjustment. Theoretical analysis establishes a one-step target-contraction property of FRC under bounded controller-state mismatch, and extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of FGMO across multiple multimodal benchmarks.

</details>


### [298] [RIPPLE in Still Water: Zero-Shot Clustering in Federated Learning with Wavelet Scattering Transform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03054)
*Alessandro Licciardi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出离线聚类联邦学习框架 RIPPLE：客户端簇分配完全离线完成，通过小波散射变换嵌入方差加权主成分原型，并用服务端高斯混合 VAE 解码；通信开销与 FedAvg 相同，未参与训练的客户端仅需一次前向即可获得个性化模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有聚类联邦学习方法在训练循环内通过梯度相似度、损失评估或 EM 更新来发现簇结构，导致通信开销增加、梯度暴露于反演攻击，且无法为未参与训练的客户端分配簇。

Method: RIPPLE 在联邦开始前于服务端离线完成簇分配：对每个客户端本地数据计算方差加权主成分原型，经小波散射变换嵌入，再由在合成客户端群体上训练的高斯混合 VAE 解码得到簇归属；训练阶段每轮通信代价与 FedAvg 完全一致。

Result: 理论上证明 RIPPLE 的代理聚类目标与 oracle 之间的差距可由可计算量界定，该量随客户端样本量衰减且与联邦时长无关；每簇收敛速率匹配非凸光滑目标的极小极大最优速率。在涵盖受控与真实异质性的五个基准上持续优于所有基线，且在最具真实性的划分上优势更大。

Conclusion: 通过将聚类分配完全离线化，RIPPLE 在不增加通信与梯度暴露风险的前提下实现聚类联邦学习，并支持对训练缺席客户端的单次前向个性化推断。

Abstract: Clustered Federated Learning (FL) partitions a client population into groups of similar local distributions and trains one specialized model per cluster, mitigating client drift that degrades single-model methods under non-IID data. Prior methods discover cluster structure inside the training loop through gradient similarity, loss evaluation, or EM-style updates, thus increasing communication overhead, exposing gradients to inversion attacks, and providing no mechanism to assign clients absent from training. We propose RIPPLE, a clustered FL framework in which cluster assignment is computed entirely offline from a spectral characterization of each client's local data: a variance-weighted principal-component prototype embedded via the Wavelet Scattering Transform and decoded by a Gaussian Mixture VAE trained server-side on synthetic client populations before federation begins. Per-round communication cost matches FedAvg exactly, and a client absent from training obtains a personalized model from a single forward pass, without gradient computation, model evaluation, or extra communication round. We prove that the gap between RIPPLE's surrogate clustered objective and the oracle is bounded by a computable quantity decaying with client sample size and independent of federation duration; per-cluster convergence matches the minimax-optimal rate for non-convex smooth objectives. Across five benchmarks spanning controlled and realistic heterogeneity, RIPPLE consistently outperforms all baselines, with margins growing on the most realistic partitions.

</details>


### [299] [When Does Synthetic Relational Data Teach Models to Use Relations? Tracing Predictive Structure from Pretraining Data to Model Behavior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03057)
*Shivam Dubey,Mohamed Bouadi,Nassim Bouarour,Varun Kulkarni,Aditya Tanna,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对"关系基础模型在使用合成数据库预训练时，究竟是数据的哪种属性诱导出关系计算能力"这一数据归因问题，采用四个使用相同架构、初始化、目标与算力的关系型Transformer检查点，分别对应四种关系数据生成器，追踪数据属性→学习到的计算→下游行为的因果链条。核心发现：当跨表信息对掩码单元预训练目标具有预测必要性时，关系机制才会涌现；RelDiff语料的预测增益对外键父表依赖最大，其模型对未见数据库上的外键干预最为敏感，该依赖在随机初始化控制下依然存在，随损坏链接比例单调增长，并定位于一条串行跨表通路；在下游推理中破坏该机制可消除RelDiff的关系任务优势。 


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关系基础模型越来越多地用合成数据库预训练，但下游基准无法解释为何某一合成语料优于另一语料。关键风险在于：模型的强表现可能仅来自逼真的行级统计，而模型从未真正学会使用关系结构。因此需要把"哪种合成数据属性诱导关系计算"形式化为数据归因问题。 

Method: 使用四个关系型Transformer检查点，架构、初始化、目标函数与算力预算完全相同，仅预训练语料不同（由四种关系数据生成器产生）。提出假设：当跨表信息对掩码单元预训练目标具有预测必要性时，关系机制才会涌现，并据此追踪可测量的数据属性到学习到的计算再到下游行为。具体手段包括：比较各语料对"外键链接父表"的预测增益；对未见数据库施加外键干预测试模型敏感度；进行随机初始化控制；按损坏链接比例做单调性分析；定位相关计算回路；在下游推理时对该机制进行干预。 

Result: RelDiff语料的外键父表预测增益远超其他生成器，其对应模型是唯一对未见数据库上的外键干预敏感的模型。这一依赖关系：在随机初始化控制下依然存在；随损坏链接比例单调增长；并定位到一条串行的跨表通路。此外，在下游推理中破坏同一机制会消除RelDiff在关系任务上的优势，而结构不敏感模型几乎不受影响。 

Conclusion: 研究将合成训练数据的一个属性与一个可学习到的机制联系起来，并通过干预进一步连接到下游行为，为构建能诱导真正关系计算能力的合成预训练语料提供了数据归因视角的因果解释。 

Abstract: Relational foundation models are increasingly pretrained on synthetic databases, yet downstream benchmarks reveal little about why one synthetic corpus produces a better model than another. In particular, strong performance may arise from realistic row-level statistics without the model ever learning to use relational structure. We study this as a data-attribution problem: which property of synthetic pretraining data induces relational computation? Using four Relational Transformer checkpoints trained with the same architecture, initialization, objective, and compute budget on corpora produced by four relational data generators, we trace a measurable property of the data to learned computation and downstream behavior. We hypothesize that relational mechanisms emerge when cross-table information is predictively necessary for the masked-cell pretraining objective. RelDiff exhibits by far the largest predictive gain from foreign-key-linked parents, and its corresponding model is uniquely sensitive to foreign-key interventions on unseen databases. This dependence survives a random-initialization control, grows monotonically with the fraction of corrupted links, and localizes to a serial cross-table pathway. Finally, disrupting the same mechanism during downstream inference removes RelDiff's advantage on relational tasks while leaving structure-insensitive models nearly unchanged. These results connect a property of synthetic training data to a learned mechanism and, through intervention, to downstream behavior.

</details>


### [300] [Learning Transferable Policies from Action-free Time Series Through Dynamical Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03065)
*Niklas Emonds,Georgia Koppe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个分层基于模型的强化学习框架，通过共享潜嵌入结构，从无动作记录中学习系统特异性控制策略，实现跨系统迁移与机制分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无动作（action-free）记录中干预效果不可观测，且策略可能利用重构动力学的误差，因此从这类数据中学习控制极具挑战。作者希望借助相关系统间的共享结构，克服干预不可观测的困难。

Method: 构建分层动力学系统重构模型，用低维嵌捕共享动力学与个体差异；这些嵌入被复用于参数化共享的策略与价值网络，将重构动力学差异与控制差异关联。策略完全通过仿真训练，采用含加性潜扰动的显式干预模型。使用分段线性循环神经网络支持受控动力学的机制分析，并通过解码器约束使干预的即时效应在观测空间可解释，且可对某一模态施加干预同时保护另一模态。

Result: 在 Lorenz-63 与双摆系统上，分层策略比独立训练策略迁移更好；在 Lorenz-63 上，其平均奖励高于用同一重构模型重复规划，与使用受控交互训练的方法相当，并能在仅做嵌入推断后泛化到策略训练中未出现的系统。应用于神经-行为记录时，展示了在受限神经扰动下对预测运动的抑制。

Conclusion: 共享动力学表示能够支持可迁移控制，并从无动作记录中生成机制性假设。

Abstract: Learning control from action-free recordings is challenging because intervention effects are unobserved and policies may exploit errors in reconstructed dynamics. We present a hierarchical model-based reinforcement learning framework that uses shared structure across related systems to learn system-specific control policies from action-free recordings. A hierarchical dynamical system reconstruction model captures shared dynamics and individual variation through low-dimensional embeddings. These embeddings are then reused to parameterize shared policy and value networks, linking differences in reconstructed dynamics to differences in control. Policies are trained entirely via simulation under an explicit intervention model with additive latent perturbations. Piecewise-linear recurrent neural networks enable mechanistic analyses of the controlled dynamics, while decoder-based constraints make the immediate effects of interventions interpretable in observation space and permit interventions on one modality while protecting another from direct manipulation. On Lorenz-63 and double-pendulum systems, hierarchical policies improve transfer over independently trained policies. On Lorenz-63, they also achieve a higher mean reward than repeated planning with the same reconstructed models, perform comparably to methods trained with controlled interactions, and generalize to systems absent from policy training after embedding inference alone. Applications to neural-behavioral recordings demonstrate suppression of predicted movement under constrained neural perturbations. Together, these findings show how shared dynamical representations support transferable control and mechanistic hypothesis generation from action-free recordings.

</details>


### [301] [Learn Feasibility Once, Optimize All Objectives: Derivative-Free Diffusion Models for Chance-Constrained Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03071)
*Ziwen Liu,Yan Liu,Congying Han,Tiande Guo,Yao Yan,Weichen Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 D³Opt：一种无导数、基于扩散的框架，将机会约束建模与目标优化解耦，学习一次可复用的风险条件先验，并在推理阶段通过退火粒子 Feynman–Kac 校正实现无需重训的目标优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机会约束规划需在约束违反概率受限下优化决策。现有传统与学习方法在优化非凸/非光滑目标方面存在困难，且当机会约束固定、目标发生变化时，往往需要针对每个目标重新训练或调整，缺乏目标泛化能力。

Method: 在仅经过约束过滤的决策上训练一个风险条件扩散模型，学习与具体目标无关的机会可行结构，并将其冻结为可复用先验。推理时在冻结的反向扩散过程中引入退火的、基于粒子的 Feynman–Kac 校正，仅用函数评估即可优化事后指定的目标，实现无导数优化，无需目标特定重训。理论证明校正可保持可行性（当冻结先验满足该性质时），并给出分离先验覆盖、有限粒子近似与有限温度效应的优化误差界。

Result: 在线性高斯机会约束规划、目标迁移任务与机会约束经济调度实验中，方法对光滑与非光滑目标（含非凸情形）均实现有效优化；在固定机会约束下无需重训即可泛化到新目标。

Conclusion: D³Opt 通过解耦约束建模与目标优化，将机会可行结构一次性学习为可复用先验，配合无导数粒子校正，为固定机会约束下多变目标提供无需重训的通用优化范式。

Abstract: Chance-constrained programs (CCPs) optimize decisions under uncertainty by limiting the probability of constraint violation. Despite advances in traditional and learning-based approaches, optimizing non-convex or non-smooth objectives and adapting to different objectives under fixed chance constraints remain challenging. In this paper, we propose a \textbf{D}erivative-free \textbf{D}iffusion-based framework that \textbf{D}isentangles constraint modeling from objective optimization, termed \textbf{D$^3$Opt}. We learn the chance-feasible structure once, independently of any particular objective, by training a risk-conditioned diffusion model solely on constraint-filtered decisions and freezing it as a reusable prior for post-specified objectives. At inference time, we propose an annealed, particle-based Feynman--Kac correction along the frozen reverse diffusion process to optimize post-specified objectives using only function evaluations. This enables derivative-free optimization of non-convex and non-smooth objectives without objective-specific retraining. We prove that the correction preserves feasibility when this property holds for the frozen prior, and derive an optimization-error bound separating learned-prior coverage, finite-particle approximation, and finite-temperature effects. Experiments on linear Gaussian CCPs, objective-transfer tasks, and chance-constrained economic dispatch demonstrate effective optimization across smooth and non-smooth objectives, including non-convex cases, and objective generalization under fixed chance constraints without retraining.

</details>


### [302] [Smart Sensing for Safer Bridges: From Sensor Signals to AI-Driven Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03082)
*Rahul Jaiswal,Joakim Hellum,Halvor Heiberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文基于挪威某桥梁的iBridge实时传感器数据，采用信号处理与数据驱动机器学习模型Isolation Forest两种互补方法进行异常检测，通过异常计数、检测时间、处理速率、异常率、可视化及时序一致性等指标评估，并进行受控异常注入分析以考察敏感性，结果表明两种方法检测特性与计算需求各异，机器学习方法具有应用潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 桥梁对交通连通性和城市发展至关重要，可靠的桥梁监测对保障公共安全、及早发现结构异常征兆具有重要意义；而真实桥梁传感器数据中的异常检测是其中的核心问题。

Method: 采用信号处理与数据驱动的机器学习模型Isolation Forest两种互补方法，对安装在挪威某桥梁上的iBridge传感器设备采集的实时桥梁传感器数据进行异常检测；评估指标包括异常计数、异常检测时间、处理速率、异常率、可视化及时序一致性，并开展受控异常注入分析以评估各方法的敏感性。

Result: 数值结果表明，两种方法具有不同的检测特性和计算需求，数据驱动的Isolation Forest与信号处理方法在识别桥梁传感器测量异常方面均展现出潜力。

Conclusion: 信号处理与机器学习方法在桥梁传感器异常检测中各有优势，机器学习尤其是数据驱动的Isolation Forest具有良好的应用前景，可作为桥梁结构健康监测的有效补充手段。

Abstract: Bridges contribute significantly to transportation connectivity and urban development. Therefore, reliable bridge monitoring is crucial for protecting public safety and detecting anomalous behavior in bridge sensor data that may provide early indications of abnormal structural conditions. This paper investigates anomaly detection in real-world bridge sensor data using two different complementary approaches, namely signal processing and the data-driven machine learning model Isolation Forest. The real-time bridge sensor data is collected from an iBridge sensor device installed on a bridge in Norway. The methods are evaluated using anomaly counts, anomaly detection time, processing rate, anomaly rates, visualization, and temporal agreement. Moreover, a controlled anomaly-injection analysis is performed to evaluate the sensitivity of each method. Numerical results demonstrate distinct detection characteristics and computational requirements, highlighting the potential of machine learning, particularly the data-driven Isolation Forest, alongside signal processing for identifying anomalies in bridge sensor measurements.

</details>


### [303] [Light Entropic Optimal Transport on Riemannian Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03085)
*Xavier Aramayo-Carrasco,Petr Mokrov,Alexander Korotin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ManifoldLightOT，一种直接在常见流形上学习核诱导熵最优传输耦合的轻量方法。通过几何特定的Gibbs核与兼容的势函数参数化，在球面、环面、SO(3)和SE(3)上实现闭式归一化与可采样条件分布，并可推广至流形乘积，性能常优于现有流形OT方法且保留直接采样能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 熵最优传输（EOT）已成为学习复杂分布间随机耦合的实用框架，广泛应用于生成建模与域适应。但多数EOT求解器面向欧氏空间，流形扩展有限，且常依赖昂贵的迭代方法、模拟动力学或通用神经模型，未能充分利用底层几何结构。因此需要一种高效且几何感知的流形EOT方法。

Method: 基于EOT解的核形式，为球面、环面、SO(3)与SE(3)构造几何特定的Gibbs核及兼容的势函数参数化，从而获得闭式归一化与可直接采样的条件分布；该框架自然推广到流形乘积。势函数参数通过蒙特卡洛估计学习目标直接由样本优化。

Result: 在合成与真实世界实验中，ManifoldLightOT在保持直接采样能力的同时，常优于现有流形OT方法。

Conclusion: ManifoldLightOT为常见流形及流形乘积提供了轻量、几何感知的EOT耦合学习方案，兼具闭式归一化、直接采样与竞争性性能，是流形上EOT求解的实用替代方案。

Abstract: Entropic Optimal Transport (EOT) has become a practical framework for learning stochastic couplings between complex distributions, with applications in generative modeling and domain adaptation. However, most EOT solvers are designed for Euclidean spaces, while manifold extensions remain limited and often rely on costly iterative methods, simulated dynamics, or generic neural models that do not fully exploit the underlying geometry. We introduce ManifoldLightOT, a light approach for learning kernel-induced EOT couplings directly on common manifolds. Using the kernel form of the EOT solution, we construct geometry-specific Gibbs kernels together with compatible potential parameterizations for spheres, tori, $\mathrm{SO}(3)$, and $\mathrm{SE}(3)$. These choices yield closed-form normalization and directly sampleable conditional distributions. Our formulation naturally extends to products of manifolds, making it applicable to more complex geometries. The parameters of the potentials are optimized directly from samples using Monte Carlo estimates of the learning objective. Through synthetic and real-world experiments, we show that ManifoldLightOT often outperforms existing manifold OT methods while retaining direct sampling.

</details>


### [304] [Zephon: Elastic Determinism for Online, Stateful Foundation Model Data Loading Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03087)
*Maximilian Böther,Josh Wills,Ties Robroek,Sonnet Xu,Paul Burstein,Daniel Zayas,Cody Blakeney,Siddharth Joshi,Haoli Yin,Rishabh Adiga,Haakon Mongstad,Luke Merrick,Pratyush Maini,Ari Morcos,Matthew Leavitt,Ana Klimovic,Bogdan Gaza*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Zephon，一种面向基础模型训练的数据加载器，支持在线有状态流水线，并提供弹性确定性（拓扑无关的全局批次序列）与高效断点恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型开发中，研究者需要确信昂贵消融实验间的差异源于所改参数而非训练数据序列的非确定性。数据加载器需具备"弹性确定性"：在GPU拓扑变化（如GPU资源稀缺）、频繁断点恢复、不同数据处理执行后端下仍保持全局训练批次序列一致。然而现代流水线在线执行tokenize、pack与mix，引入有状态的n对多变换，破坏了样本索引；现有加载器多假设可索引的1对1流水线，而离线物化代价高昂，对视频等模态甚至不可行。

Method: Zephon将全局数据流划分为与拓扑无关的lane，串行化顺序决策而在可互换后端上并行无状态工作，并仅对有限的在途状态做检查点，使恢复成本不随训练进度增长。

Result: 在文本与视觉-语言工作负载上评估，Zephon在保持有竞争力吞吐的同时，提供了现有加载器在线有状态流水线下均不具备的多项保证组合。

Conclusion: Zephon为在线有状态流水线同时实现弹性确定性与高效恢复，弥补了现有加载器在拓扑变化、频繁恢复与多后端场景下的能力空白。

Abstract: Deterministic data loading is important for foundation model development: model researchers need confidence that differences they observe across costly ablations are caused by the parameter they changed rather than non-determinism in the training data sequence. The data loader must provide elastic determinism, i.e., a deterministic sequence of global training data batches despite changes to the GPU topology across runs (e.g., due to GPU scarcity), frequent checkpoint-resume cycles, and different data processing execution backends. Achieving this is difficult because modern foundation model data pipelines tokenize, pack, and mix samples online, introducing stateful n-to-m transformations that break sample indexing. Existing data loaders largely assume indexable 1-to-1 pipelines, and the common workaround of offline materialization is expensive and, for some modalities such as video, infeasible.
  We present Zephon, a data loader for foundation models that supports online, stateful pipelines while providing elastic determinism and efficient resumption from checkpoints. It partitions the global stream into topology-independent lanes, serializes ordering decisions while parallelizing stateless work on interchangeable backends, and checkpoints only bounded in-flight state so recovery cost does not grow with training progress. We evaluate Zephon on text and vision-language workloads and show that it achieves competitive throughput while providing a combination of guarantees that no existing loader offers for online, stateful pipelines.

</details>


### [305] [ULTRADISCOVERY: Abductive Exploration in an Interconnected, Epistemically Open Universe](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03092)
*Weihan Li,Tianshi Zheng,Yangqiu Song,Ginny Y. Wong,Simon See*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出ULTRASTUDY/ULTRADISCOVERY交互式基准，用5个领域的2×2设计解耦"表征开放性"与"证据分布性"两个溯因发现难点，发现现有模型难以完成从证据积累到表征重构的跨越。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学发现常在零散线索要求新描述方式时发生，此类溯因探索面临两重需求：在世界认知开放时构建解释所需的表征，以及在结构互联时整合跨情境的分散证据。现有基准很少区分这两者，也无法独立控制，因此难以定位模型能力瓶颈。

Method: 引入ULTRADISCOVERY交互环境：包含5个领域，智能体需修正一个初始成功的理论并预测未见的跨域干预结果。采用2×2设计：表征"开放/已披露"、证据"分散/对齐"，同时固定潜在动力学。测试11个模型及两个厂商-框架系统。

Result: 表征开放时，多数模型常撤回被教授的公理，且无一引入未观察实体或改写所需变量；披露表征使干预请求增至三倍并多发现约十八分之一，证据对齐增益更小。两个厂商系统能扩展到更多领域，其一在开放回合中改写变量；在200次付费动作内无一系统作出精确预测；更大预算下，双重辅助时出现一次精确预测，而所有开放回合仍不精确。

Conclusion: 难点定位于"从证据积累到将其组合为可迁移表征"的这一步。即使提供表征披露与证据对齐等辅助，开放情境下的表征重构仍未被现有系统攻克，指出现有模型在溯因发现中的核心能力缺口。

Abstract: Scientific discovery often begins when scattered clues call for a new way of describing the world. Such abductive exploration can require constructing the representation in which an explanation is stated, when the world is epistemically open, and composing evidence scattered across contexts, when it is structurally interconnected. Existing benchmarks rarely separate these two demands or control them independently. We introduce ULTRADISCOVERY, an interactive world of five domains in which an agent revises an initially successful theory and predicts the outcome of an unseen cross-domain intervention. A $2 \times 2$ design leaves the representation open or discloses it, and leaves the evidence distributed or aligns it, with the latent dynamics fixed. With the representation open, agents across eleven models often retract the axiom they were taught, and none introduces the unobserved entity or rewrites the variables that a replacement requires. Disclosure triples intervention requests and adds about one of the eighteen findings the world affords, and alignment adds less. Two vendor-harness systems carry discovery into more domains, and one of them rewrites the variables in Open episodes. No system makes the exact prediction within 200 paid actions. At larger budgets one exact prediction appears with both aids, while every Open episode remains inexact. The results locate the difficulty in the step from accumulating evidence to composing it into a representation that transfers.

</details>


### [306] [LS-AR: Future-Predictive Latent Steering in Autoregressive LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03093)
*Anubha Gupta,Eduardo Pignatelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent-Steered Autoregressive (LS-AR)，一种通过 FiLM 条件将连续目标引导与离散 token 解码解耦的双通道自回归架构，在长程检索与规划任务中显著优于参数匹配基线，并揭示了其潜在向量攻击面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准自回归模型将高层任务指令、状态历史与瞬态 token 混于单一共享序列中，缺乏将宏观目标与上下文噪声隔离的架构机制，存在单通道瓶颈。

Method: 提出 LS-AR 双通道架构，通过 FiLM 条件实现连续目标引导（goal steering）与离散 token 解码的解耦；分别评估 Static Goal Encoder（P_0，用于长 rollout 中持久宏观目标保持）与 Dynamic State Tracker（P_t，用于生成过程中的循环潜在更新）。

Result: 在超越上下文长度的长程检索（H=1024, W=500）中，LS-AR (Static) 达到 100% 目标召回，而参数匹配基线崩溃至 0%，同时吞吐量提升约 35%，峰值 VRAM 降低 52.8%；在强制扰动（k=1）的 Blocksworld 规划中，LS-AR (Dynamic) 完成率为 89.0%，基线为 71.0%；但零样本实体扩展（N -> N+1）暴露单向量容量限制（0%）；双通道权威分析表明文本目标 dropout 可建立潜在主导控制，对文本 prompt 注入形成结构性防御，同时引入潜在向量攻击面。

Conclusion: 双通道解耦架构有效隔离宏观目标与上下文噪声，在长程任务中大幅提升召回与效率；但单向量潜在表示存在容量瓶颈，且潜在通道带来新的安全攻击面，需进一步研究。

Abstract: Standard autoregressive (AR) models process high-level task instructions, state history, and transient tokens within a single shared sequence of tokens. Consequently, they lack the architectural mechanisms needed to isolate macro-objectives from context noise. To overcome this single-channel limitation, we introduce Latent-Steered Autoregressive (LS-AR), a dual-channel architecture that decouples continuous goal steering from discrete token decoding via FiLM conditioning. We evaluate a Static Goal Encoder (P_0) for persistent macro-objective retention across long rollouts and a Dynamic State Tracker (P_t) for recurrent latent updates during generation. On long-horizon retrieval past context limits (H=1024, W=500), LS-AR (Static) achieves 100% target recall where parameter-matched baselines collapse (0%), while increasing throughput by ~35% and cutting peak VRAM by 52.8%. In Blocksworld planning under forced perturbations (k=1), LS-AR (Dynamic) sustains an 89.0% completion rate vs. 71.0% for the baseline, though zero-shot entity scaling (N -> N+1) exposes single-vector capacity limits (0%). Finally, dual-channel authority analysis shows that text goal dropout establishes latent-dominant control, offering structural defence against text prompt injection while introducing a latent vector attack surface.

</details>


### [307] [Exploring the Trade-Off Between Structured Pruning and Fault Tolerance in Deep Neural Networks for Space Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03117)
*Toon Vinck,Naïn Jonckers,Jaro De Roose,Jeffrey Prinzie,Peter Karsmakers*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文实证研究了DNN模型宽度与单粒子翻转（SEU）鲁棒性的关系，发现结构化剪枝虽提高单次推理的故障敏感度，但缩短的执行时间降低了遭遇SEU的概率，两者相互抵消。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DNN因信息的分布式表示而对位级故障具有一定内在鲁棒性，且理论上模型越宽信息越分散、单个位故障影响越小。作者希望实证验证宽度与SEU鲁棒性之间的关系，为面向空间应用的高可靠AI系统设计提供依据。

Method: 对基线模型进行迭代式结构化剪枝以在不损失任务性能的前提下减小宽度；在每一剪枝阶段开展针对性的故障注入实验，评估模型在模拟位翻转情形下的性能表现。

Result: 结构化剪枝因减少冗余而提高了单次推理的故障敏感度，但这一负面影响被更短的执行时间所抵消，后者降低了遭遇SEU的概率。

Conclusion: 结构化剪枝可在不牺牲整体可靠性的前提下带来显著的能耗与时延节省，为空间应用中鲁棒AI系统的设计提供了有益指导。

Abstract: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) inherently exhibit a degree of robustness to bit-level faults due to their distributed representation of information. As a model increases in width, this information becomes more dispersed, theoretically reducing the impact of any single bit fault. In this paper, we empirically investigate the relationship between model width and robustness to Single Event Upsets (SEUs). We conduct a comprehensive experiment in which baseline models undergo iterative structured pruning to reduce their width while preserving task performance as much as possible. At each pruning stage, we run a targeted fault-injection campaign to evaluate the model's performance under simulated bit-flip scenarios. Our results show that, although structured pruning increases per-inference sensitivity to faults by reducing redundancy, this effect is effectively counterbalanced by shorter execution time, which lowers the probability of encountering an SEU. These findings suggest that structured pruning can yield significant energy and latency savings without compromising overall reliability, providing useful guidance for designing robust AI systems for space applications.

</details>


### [308] [How to Find and Reuse Policies for Continuous Adaptation in Lifelong Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03119)
*Saptarshi Nath,Inish M. D'Souza,Antonio Carta,Soheil Kolouri,Andrea Soltoggio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出AMSC方法，通过在线经验估计任务相似度来选择与加权历史策略，实现终身强化学习中的知识复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在终身强化学习中，仅保留旧策略不足以有效迁移；有用知识可能分散在多个历史策略中，且其相关性会随学习过程变化，因此需要检验任务相似度能否作为选择与组合已有策略的有效依据。

Method: 设计Adaptive Mask Selection and Composition（AMSC）：基于状态-动作-奖励样本，用非参数Wasserstein任务嵌入在线估计策略间相似度；对相似度分数做z-score标准化后施加sparsemax，得到可变大小的支撑集，周期性地选择并加权历史策略，组成学习新任务时的先验。
